# JULIUS FIRMICUS MATERNUS

<margin>♒</margin> If **Aquarius** <note>original: ♒</note> is found in the **Ascendant** <term>horosc.: the "Horoscope" or Rising Sign, representing the self and the beginning of life</term>, whatever the person achieves, he will later squander through some kind of ruin. Whatever he possesses or seeks, he will lose again; yet, what was lost he will generally recover with ease. He will take many people under his care and provide sustenance to many. However, those to whom he has happened to grant anything will be stained with the vice of ingratitude toward him. He will also be placed in grave danger and despaired of by men, but he will be delivered by the protection of the gods. He will be struck by the screeching of envy from many, yet he will handle the duties of divine literature, sacred rites, or religions, and will be known to great men on account of his good deeds. If, however, **Aquarius** is in the **Midheaven** <term>MC: Medium Coeli, the highest point in the sky, representing career and public status</term>, he will be strong, but his life or social interactions will be shaken by hardship, and he will move from place to place. If he is free-born <note>original: ingenuus</note>, he will perform the duties of a servant, but afterward, a prosperous outcome will follow him in all things. Nevertheless, regarding his wife and children, he will suffer through wretched misfortunes at the beginning; but later, through his acquaintance with greater men, happiness will be granted to him. If **Leo** <note>original: ♌</note> is the **Descendant** <term>occasus: the West, representing marriage and partnerships</term> <note>When Aquarius is rising, Leo is always setting on the opposite horizon.</note>, he will disagree with his wife with varying degrees of hostility; for he will join in marriage with an unworthy woman, or with an elderly woman, or one who is seized by various fires of passion. He will also suffer treachery from his own family, and enemies will rise against him with sudden actions; yet by his own strength and virtue, he will carry off another man’s legal wife, or another’s betrothed, or he will certainly contract a marriage with a widow. If, however, the **Lower Midheaven** <term>IMC: Imum Coeli, the lowest point in the sky, representing the home, roots, and the end of life</term> is in **Taurus** <note>original: ♉</note>, he will be great, he will associate with many powerful people, and he will have glory in all things. He will govern the property of many to such an extent that, on account of the integrity of his discipline, many things will be entrusted to him. After a great span of time, he will die, oppressed by the long weight of service <note>Alternatively: "the burden of old age."</note>, provided that the Lord of the Nativity <note>The planet that rules the birth chart.</note>, following the power of its own condition and placed in the principal places of the nativity, adorned by both sign and degree, has decreed for him the full number of his time.

<margin>♓</margin> If **Pisces** <note>The OCR uses 'X' as a placeholder for the Pisces symbol ♓.</note> is in the **Ascendant**, the person will be talented, wise, faithful, a friend, and a close companion, and he will be promoted by certain businesses—yet in such a way that another power is preferred over his own power and honors. He will have enemies, but he will be avenged of them by the easiest means, and he will achieve glory from certain local businesses. As time proceeds, he will be allotted the ornaments of greater dignity and will have an increase of great happiness; he will continually come to the notice of many, being well-known through his travels. If, however, the **Midheaven** is in **Pisces**, he will be entangled in many errors and will approach various turning points of danger. He will be agile in all his social interactions and will have no small struggles with more powerful persons. But on account of a certain person, he will incur various plots and will lose everything he first possessed, only to again achieve mastery over the property of others, always exhibiting a faithful bond of friendship to his friends. Yet, the desires gathered through his eyes will always drive him toward sexual unions. If, however, the **Descendant** is in **Virgo** <note>original: ♍</note>, he will be wise and will provide sustenance to foreign men. He will be the kind of person to whom faithful secrets are entrusted, and he will relieve many friends with his food and protection. A great heap of riches will come to him, but his friends will frequently be ungrateful toward him. Regarding his wife, he will be bound by charming affects of love, yet she herself will frequently be ungrateful toward him. He himself will suffer heavy torments of grief from the misfortune of his wife or children. If, however, the **Lower Midheaven** is found in **Gemini** <note>original: ♊</note>, he will be fatigued by many illnesses and applied to many labors, and he will have some hidden pain or defect. But after the inconveniences of unhappiness, the greatest happiness will be granted to him, so that he even supplies the sustenance of life to others. For having lost all his prior possessions by some sudden chance, he will return to riches; for he will possess and have resources which supply everything to him. But when he is oppressed by the burden of old age, he will die a sudden death in foreign places.

<margin>♓</margin> But in this matter, the Lord of the Nativity should also be sought. Some will think that these things are stated differently elsewhere in a nativity, but their substance is one: for all these individual signs decree by their own power. If you read the *Myriogenesis* <term>Myriogenesis: A lost Greek astrological work attributed to Aesculapius (Hermes Trismegistus), meaning "The Ten Thousand Births"</term> of Aesculapius, which he professed the venerable star of Mercury <note>original: ☿</note> had revealed to him, you will find the orders of all nativities explained from individual minutes <note>A "minute" here refers to a 1/60th subdivision of a zodiac degree.</note>, without any addition of the planets. For in the individual horoscopes of men, it determines the whole order of life, all acts, and likewise all forms; but it proves only the final day in a nativity to be dangerous, by likely and most manifest reasons. For since there are thirty parts <note>degrees</note> in individual signs, and a thousand minutes...

Therefore, let us follow the footsteps of divine men, and whatever has been handed down by them, let us translate with clear interpretations. 

But I do not wish, Lollianus, our pride and joy, for the *myriogenesis* <term>myriogenesis: a complex system of dividing each degree of the zodiac into many smaller parts—literally "ten thousand births"—to determine highly specific destinies</term> to be sought in these books of ours. When our modest self has completed this work, with the favor of a propitious deity, then I will make known to you the remaining secrets in another twelve books. For now, I will treat certain matters, and then step by step descend to the rest. Indeed, we cannot otherwise arrive at the *myriogenesis* unless our mind has first learned the secrets of the primary instruction. Since we have spoken generally about what the pivots of the sky <note>The "cardines" or angles: Ascendant, Midheaven, Descendant, and Imum Coeli</note> signify, let us now explain more particularly what the **Ascendant** <term>horoscopus: the degree of the zodiac rising on the eastern horizon at the moment of birth</term> does when positioned in the bounds of the stars. 

Receive what we say with an intent mind and commit it to memory through constant reading; for otherwise, you will not be able to explain the fates of men unless a tenacious memory has possessed all these things through frequent practice.

### THE DECREES OF THE ASCENDANT IN ASSOCIATION WITH ALL THE PLANETS. Chapter II.

<margin>Ascendant in the bounds of Saturn</margin>
In the bounds <term>finibus: also known as "terms," these are specific degrees within a zodiac sign ruled by a particular planet</term> of **Saturn** <note>original: ♄</note>, if the **Ascendant** is found, it will make people always lazy and slow, obscure with a deep silence of mind, evil, malicious, and those who are always separated from every grace of goodness; those whose plans always have slow effects, who pursue everyone with various types of hatred, and whose perpetual angers continue with indignation. 

But if, while the Ascendant is in the bounds of **Saturn**, **Saturn** himself is found in those same parts, he will deny the native brothers; or he will strike down whoever is born with a wretched death, or he decrees the misfortune of perpetual childlessness, so that the offspring of children is always denied to them. 

If, however, **Jupiter** <note>original: ♃</note> is found in the bounds of **Saturn**—that is, where the **Ascendant** is positioned—it will make them narrow-minded, greedy, sordid, and those who avoid the grace of joy in all of life, always entangled in servile pursuits and habits; and those who transfer all their substance to others under the title of a gift. 

But if **Mars** <note>original: ♂</note> is found in those same parts, it will make them wicked, cruel, and possessed by the bitterness of total malice, and those who, in various types of acts, either always hire themselves out or sell themselves for various deeds; but their malice and crime can never be hidden. For their wickedness and evil purpose are uncovered by the heat of their own rashness. 

If, however, the **Sun** <note>original: ☉</note> is found in those same parts, it makes them temperate in habits, but armed with the poison of all malice, and those who always leave their plans imperfect and incomplete. 

If, however, **Venus** <note>original: ♀</note> is found in those same parts, regarding sexual unions <note>original: uenereos coitus</note>, it will make them sordid, and those who always desire the things of others with envious greed. 

If **Mercury** <note>original: ☿</note> is found in those same parts, it will make them sordid in all social interactions, and those who are frequently handed over to prison and public custody, or who, because of a crime, are always entangled in wretched crises. 

But if the **Moon** <note>original: ☽</note> was increasing in those parts, or full of light, it will render them vain in mind and body; but if it was diminished in light, it corrupts the whole body with malignant humors, and either makes them dropsical <term>hydropicos: suffering from edema or an accumulation of fluid in the body</term>, or deformed by a livid paleness, or certainly decrees detestable insanities.

<margin>Jupiter</margin>

If, however, **Saturn** or **Mars** is found in those same parts, and it is a nocturnal birth, it will make them treacherous, and those who never fulfill the faith of their promises, feigning wisdom and thinking themselves to be wise, but humble in life and depressed by a wretched squalor of sadness. But if they are found in these bounds during the day, all these things are mitigated to some extent. 

If, however, the **Sun** is found in these parts, it decrees these same things as the **Moon** by a similar reasoning. 

But if **Venus** is found in these parts, it renders them fit for all duties of goodness; but a prosperous outcome will never follow in their marriage. They will nevertheless be kind, capturing the fruit of all good things with constant happiness.

### The Bounds of Mars (♂)

If the **Ascendant** <term>horoscopus: the degree of the zodiac rising on the eastern horizon</term> is found in the bounds of **Mars** (♂), it will make people who are always armed with a sharp spirit. But if **Mars** (♂) itself is in these same bounds, and it is a diurnal birth <note>a birth occurring during the day</note>, it leads the person toward every kind of criminal outrage and the perverse desire of madness; it also renders them reckless, entangled in frequent cases of misfortune, and worn down by the work of constant labor.

If, however, **Saturn** (♄) is in these bounds in a nocturnal birth <note>a birth occurring at night</note>, it makes them strong, cruel, irreligious, rapacious, and those who squander the property of others through various acts of plunder. But if **Saturn** (♄) is in these same bounds <insert>regardless of the time of birth</insert>, it will make them sharp, but people whose angers persist with perpetual indignation.

If **Jupiter** (♃) is in these bounds, it will similarly make them sharp, but people who desire to provide everything to everyone. If the **Sun** (☉) is found in these parts, it makes them clever, but those who are both sought after by and overwhelmed by plots.

If **Venus** (♀) is found in these parts, it always indicates a desire for adulterers and causes these same adulteries to be committed; it renders such people who cultivate themselves toward every kind of beauty, so that they are said to be handsome, and to whom all benefits are conferred through the affections of men.

If **Mercury** (☿) is found in these parts, it will make them strong and homicidal, and those who desire illicit sexual encounters with boys with a nefarious desire of lusts; they will be extravagant, profuse, and among whom no sign of truth is ever found; ingenious, but always dancing in wanton drunkenness, and striving to spend their resources without counsel.

If, however, the **Moon** (☽) is found in these parts, it makes those who look upon their adversaries with various schemes, and who in turn are watched by those same adversaries with similar methods. These people will also be overwhelmed by the labors of constant work and will suffer the pain of a bitter wound from fire or iron. But if it is a diurnal birth and the **Moon** (☽) is full of light, it grants a strong bodily substance. If it is a nocturnal birth and the **Moon** (☽) is waning in light, it makes them strong, with a body bolstered by suitable power, and those who are moved by various and everlasting travels and commotions; but for these, a violent death is always decreed.

### The Bounds of Venus (♀)

If the **Ascendant** is found in the bounds of **Venus** (♀), it will make musicians or lovers of the same, people who are good, kind, benevolent, gentle, and who desire to be useful to everyone. If it is a diurnal birth and **Venus** (♀) herself is found in these parts, she decrees the insignia of great dignities, and friendship with powerful men or emperors will deservedly happen; she also decrees the increase of prosperous offspring.

If **Saturn** (♄) is found in these bounds and it is a diurnal birth, it will make mockers of women and those who curse marital affections. But if it is a nocturnal birth, it makes them impure, unchaste, filthy, and entangled in the vices of miserable lust, and those who cannot come to natural intercourse; instead, they are carried away against nature by a preposterous madness of lust, and who always wander with various and changeable plans, cursing all good men with bitter hatreds.

If **Jupiter** (♃) is found in these parts, it makes them tender and lustful, but set apart from all the envy of cruelty; they are drawn to every duty of mercy; they are artistic, famous, and attain offices of honor in temples.

If **Mars** (♂) is found in these bounds and it is a diurnal birth, it decrees the inconveniences of sudden disturbance, upsets the established orders of life, and always pursues the person with popular sedition, or various inconveniences of danger because of women. It certainly makes musicians, always devoted to sweet instruments, or dedicated to the poetic arts; or certainly it will make sculptors, decorators, or mechanics; it decrees subtle inconveniences for these arts, but nevertheless renders them musicians by talent.

If it is a nocturnal birth and **Mars** (♂) is found in these parts, it will give marriage to a most powerful and noble woman, so that through her an abundance of magnificent riches is conferred upon him; but he will be tortured by the pain of anxiety from excessive jealousy.

If the **Sun** (☉) is found in these bounds, it decrees prosperous acts by constant reason, but from marriage it will give the inconveniences of miserable dissension; however, it decrees profits from elsewhere and joins the person in friendship with powerful men, so that they may shine by their prosperous recommendations.

If **Mercury** (☿) is found in these bounds, it will make them lustful, but always adorned with goodness of character; wise also, and those who strive to benefit everyone, grammarians, astrologers, divine poets...

124 JULIUS FIRMICUS MATERNUS

Because we have spoken of all the decrees of the Ascendant <term>horoscopus: the degree of the zodiac rising on the eastern horizon</term> in detail <note>original: "partiliter," referring to predictions made degree-by-degree</note>, let us now briefly explain what the stars decree when positioned in individual signs. We do this so that when a malicious reader receives our books, he may not say we have denied him anything out of the bitterness of envy.

### SATURN’S DECREES THROUGH THE INDIVIDUAL ZODIAC
### signs. Chapter III.

<margin>Saturn (♄) in Aries</margin> If **Saturn** (♄) is found in **Aries** (♈), and it is a daytime birth, in the first stage of life he causes one to be involved in evil and unhappy actions, and to be hindered in all things. But once Saturn has completed its first circuit—that is, the first thirty years—it diminishes the inheritance from the father and mother. Whatever the person receives from these resources, they will always diminish or lose it, and they will be exhausted by constant losses and occurring damages. However, after Saturn has taken away the resources of the original estate, with the passage of time it will cause another substance of patrimony to be granted to them. These people will certainly be sickly and at risk; and as they run into their "hebdomatic" or "enneatic" years <term>years occurring in multiples of seven (hebdomatic) or nine (enneatic), considered critical turning points in ancient medicine and astrology</term>, they will undergo heavy trials of danger. They will be overwhelmed by these dangers unless they are liberated by the protection of a benevolent star at that time. 

If Saturn itself is the ruler of the birth chart in the first stage of life, the person will disagree with his wife, and with rising dissent, he will certainly avoid a first-time marriage <note>literally "virginal nuptials"</note>; his wife will soon be separated from him either by sudden death or by divorce. Saturn positioned this way also gives either a widow as a wife, or one previously disgraced by another, or one who has had children by another husband, or one whom the stain of some foulness defames. But it decrees such a wife only when Saturn is the time-lord <term>parodicus: the planet currently acting as the ruler of a specific period of life</term>, or when the **Moon** (☽) looks upon him from a "square" aspect <term>an angle of 90 degrees, usually considered tense</term>, or if it regards him from **Leo** (♌) or from a "trine" radiation <term>an angle of 120 degrees, considered harmonious</term>. For when Saturn is so positioned, whatever wife the person has obtained, it makes her compliant to him, and she will persevere with him in untainted affection until the very end of life. He will also obtain children whenever Saturn is found in the manner we have described. For then he will successfully receive offspring, especially if, while Saturn is in Aries, **Venus** (♀) and the **Moon** (☽) look upon him with some aspect. If this is not the case, he will either lose the children he received or it certainly decrees none at all. But if Saturn should return to Aries <note>the Saturn return</note>, it threatens grave danger from a high place and embitters brothers with the harsh hatreds of enmity.

<margin>Taurus</margin> If it is found in **Taurus** (♉), it will make those who grow in all their actions by their own strength. But whatever they receive in their first stage of life, it diminishes, and then they must seek a great abundance of substance for themselves through their own efforts. In their early youth, however, they will be weighed down by various instabilities and will be subject to others, and they will flatter more powerful men out of necessity. For they will have difficult early times, and in those years they will be exhausted by heavy illness, and through a lack of necessities, they will suffer many narrow straits in life. In the first stage of life they will also labor under the inflammation of festering wounds and will be bound by certain great vices; after being oppressed by great sicknesses and then liberated from these trials of misfortune, they will attain a long span of life. 

Nevertheless, all the father’s substance will be dissipated, and they will receive nothing of the remains from the paternal or maternal estate through their own labors. Saturn positioned thus also causes the mother to be weighed down by the loss of the patrimony and the narrowness of poverty, reaching even the misery of begging—unless the star **Venus** (♀), granting testimony to Saturn with good aspects, relieves the misfortunes of the mother’s unhappiness. Nor is this testimony of Venus alone enough, unless the **Moon** (☽) also regards Venus with a prosperous aspect in the birth chart. In their own places and by their own merit, the greatest signs of happiness are conferred; but they are weighed down by the burden of unhappiness for as long as it takes Saturn to complete its first circuit of the circle <note>the 30-year cycle</note>. Dangers will be brought upon them either from legal cases, or from illnesses, or from travels. They will also have grave danger in either the 9th year, or the 14th, or the 25th, or the 32nd. But if at the time of the dangers they are liberated by the protection of benevolent stars, they evade the trial of imminent death and receive a life span up to the 64th year. For in these times they will be involved in ambushes, lawsuits, and losses. But if at the time of the dangers they have the protection of benevolent stars, they are liberated from all of them. Before thirty-two years, however, Saturn never allows them to take wives. Nor will virgin wives be given to them; and if they are given, they will receive lost children from them, and those who are strangers to their affections. But foreign...

<margin>Gemini (♊)</margin> If **Saturn** (♄) is found in **Gemini** (♊), it will cause the first stage of life to be involved in dangers and sicknesses, and the person to suffer easily from every kind of crisis. But those crises will surely be more dangerous which are inflicted during the "hebdomatic" or "enneatic" years <term>years occurring in multiples of seven (hebdomatic) or nine (enneatic), which ancient astrologers viewed as critical turning points</term>. Anyone in whose birth chart Saturn is found in this position will have dangerous times until the age of twenty-four. Let him therefore beware of sicknesses during those years, and especially when Saturn is in the "square sides" <note>original: "quadratis lateribus," referring to the 90-degree square aspect in astrology, often considered challenging</note> of this sign. For he will have disturbances and rivalries, and will often be engaged in great labors, and will obtain nothing of significance from the estate of his father or mother. Instead, he will be weighed down by the burdens of labor and misfortune for as long as it takes Saturn to pass through **Aries** (♈), **Taurus** (♉), and their squares.

But indeed, he will make progress in all things when Saturn completes its first station in **Leo** (♌) or **Scorpio** (♏). Saturn positioned in Gemini also creates vices and decrees great adversaries in lawsuits and contests; it will also grant swift and frequent losses of inheritance, so that the person is tossed about by various conflicts. But when he has come to the final crises of life, Saturn will afterwards grant great business and power by the command of another, and will cause him to associate with famous and powerful men for the sake of honor. In all his actions he will then be famous and noble, and he will travel abroad constantly, moving to various regions. 

However, a virgin wife will not be given to this man. But if the testimony of **Jupiter** (♃) should perhaps grant a virgin wife, Saturn will separate them either by divorce or by the crisis of death. Moreover, he will be without children, or will father only one son. But when Saturn reaches the sign of **Virgo** (♍), then he will be happy, glorious, and wealthy; yet he will nevertheless take a widow for a wife, with whom he will remain without any quarrel of dissension. Many matters will also be entrusted to him, but he will refuse many, and he will have many rivalries with more powerful men. He will be at risk from these men, however, unless the star of **Jupiter** (♃), running well in the birth chart at that time, mitigates the severity of these dangers. 

For the man who has Saturn thus will not always be great, but will be contrary to powerful men, always seeking the protection of inferiors for himself; and he will frequently be placed in "free custody" <term>libera custodia: a form of house arrest or detention in a private home rather than a public prison</term>. He will also grow out his hair <note>long hair was often a sign of mourning, religious vows, or social distress in the Roman world</note>, either because of some friendship, or because of trouble, or misfortune, or the miserable torments of someone's death or loss. But when he has been shaken by various types of danger, then he will be raised up by such prosperous happiness that he obtains both praise and inheritance, and a sudden legacy may come to him. Then also he will obtain riches, power over the greatest estates, and high lordships.

<margin>Cancer (♋)</margin> If **Saturn** (♄) is found in **Cancer** (♋), like a "crab among crabs," it will involve them in seditions and lawsuits and in many oppositions; and whatever they have obtained from father or mother, they will always lose through miserable tearing-apart. But later, by their own strength and their own virtue, they will obtain a very great estate; and such will be their life, that they are always both seeking and losing. Yet they will have dangers from some disturbance or from sicknesses, and most especially in the hebdomatic and enneatic years, and for as long as they are passing through their twenty-third year of age; for until this age, they will always be exhausted by the greatest dangers. 

But if, at the time of these dangers, benevolent stars hold the lordship of the times, or if the **Moon** (☽) regards them with a prosperous ray <note>astrological aspect</note>, or if the ruler of the birth chart is a benevolent star and is well-placed, they mitigate the severity of the approaching dangers. For if at the time of the dangers, as we have said, the birth chart is aided by benevolent stars, there will nonetheless be losses of parents for the native, or of brothers, or damages from the conflicts of lawsuits; but he will nevertheless be liberated from all these dangers. 

When Saturn is in its own houses <note>referring to Capricorn and Aquarius, or perhaps specific divisions of Cancer in this context</note>, then it decrees losses, storms, dangers, sicknesses, and lawsuits by constant reason. But when it is found in the "diameter" <note>opposition, 180 degrees away</note> of its own houses, it threatens these same things by a similar reason. When it is in "double signs" <note>Gemini, Pisces, Virgo, or Sagittarius</note>, it will always agitate those born and involve them in sudden anxieties and dangers. For then it indicates misfortunes, and will shake them with a continuation of these evils for as long as it passes through the sign of **Cancer** (♋). 

But when Saturn is in the "tropical parts" <term>the degrees of the solstice, where the sun appears to "turn" back</term> of Cancer, then it will cause the loss of inheritance and will place them in such great straits that the charity of others must support them. For then there will be shameful seditions and various crises of life. But when Saturn has passed the tropical parts of Cancer, the preceding evils will be lightly put to rest, and they will be separated from all anxieties, cares, and dangers. Yet the first wife will never remain, nor will a happy outcome ever follow them in their first contracts. For in the first part of life, with lower-class women...

Such individuals will also be somewhat deformed by an unwholesome complexion: they will be dark-skinned and colored by an abundance of bile, suffering constant troubles from "black bile" <note>original: "nigro felle," referring to the humor of melancholy which was thought to cause depression and physical illness</note>. In times of sickness, their recovery will certainly be despaired of, and they will regain their health with difficulty. Yet they will be simple in spirit, humane, and merciful, relieving the distress of others and even taking up the inheritances of others, obtaining the support for their life from these. They will even be fathers to the children of others, while harboring hidden vices; they will be endowed with such dignity that they will even seem to be the masters of their own brothers. They will also be wealthy and moneyed, known to many powerful men, but slow in all their actions and reluctant to be quickly involved in public occupations. Separated from all servitude, they will be adorned with honorable riches and splendors of the soul, ruling their lives with consistently prosperous plans.

<margin>Leo (♌)</margin>
If **Saturn** (♄) is found in **Leo** (♌), those born will be hounded by constant envy, though they will possess strength in their early years. They will sometimes be destined for famous and glorious arts, and from these they will achieve the greatest honors and receive the ornaments of the highest happiness. At other times, however, they will be separated from these activities—indeed, even devoid of any administrative role. They will receive nothing from their parents, or if they do receive anything, they will lose it. In their early age and youth, they will be listless, in danger, and involved in many preoccupations; they will also suffer certain torments of the body and be exhausted by extreme pains. They will also have hidden vices or pains, and will never be able to marry virgins; yet if they have obtained them by force, they will be separated from them in a short time. Nor will it be profitable for them to marry such wives, for they will never have children by them as long as **Saturn** (♄) has not completed its first cycle <note>the "Saturn Return," which occurs roughly every 29.5 years</note>. For until that time, they will achieve neither marriage, nor inheritance, nor any glory; rather, whatever they have achieved before this time, they will lose. 

**Saturn** (♄) positioned in this sign also decrees two marriages. But if, beyond this number, they have known any woman through some long-standing relationship, they either always cast them away or "carry them out" <note>original: "efferunt," a Latin euphemism for carrying a body out for burial, implying the death of the partner</note>. They will also have sorrows from the misfortunes of their children, unless the **Moon** (☾) is either with Saturn or moving toward it. But whenever Saturn enters the "tropical signs" <note>the cardinal signs: Aries, Cancer, Libra, and Capricorn</note>, it decrees many troubles. Likewise, when its transit brings it into **Pisces** (♓) and **Gemini** (♊), it decrees these same things as it does in the tropical signs. 

In the other signs, however, it will be of the greatest benefit. For then it decrees even the rewards of glory—though uncertain—yet in business and actions and in all of life, these people are constantly changing through reason. For they will sail great rivers and seas, and make journeys through desert places; and whatever their parents did not do, they themselves will complete with very easy methods. They will also have very many brothers, either from another father or mother, but they will be better than all their kindred, raised up by the grace of very powerful dignity. They will certainly be very wise, enemies of foreigners, and prone to anger, yet good, benevolent, and learned. They will serve with incorruptible faith in all contracts, being of good counsel and of upright and uncorrupted mind; they will be friends to many and will maintain all things with very strong power. They will also have a scar on some part of the body and will constantly endure losses of status, so that they frequently slip from a high rank of dignity into some lowly downfall. They will also have wealth brought to them from the generosity of another, but in such an amount that they can relieve the distress of others. They will also be defenders of children, always providing patronage to people who are struggling. But when they have achieved all these things, they will die at a great age, and their souls are joined to heaven. When positioned in **Leo** (♌), Saturn recalls the souls of those who have it thus—freed from innumerable distresses—back to heaven and the origins of their own beginning, placing them in a quiet seat.

<margin>Virgo (♍)</margin>
If **Saturn** (♄) is found in **Virgo** (♍), those born will suffer illnesses and the troubles of life in their early age. They are involved in even stronger evils when Saturn makes a transit to the **Moon** (☾) or to its own place, or when it enters the "double signs" <note>the mutable signs: Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, and Pisces</note>. For in these signs it decrees disturbances, losses, anxieties, pains, and the sudden ruin of dangers. But passing through other signs, it decrees good actions, good occupations, and the ornament of good happiness, so that from these actions they achieve both an increase of inheritance and glory—or certainly from the troubles...

And when they have felt the advantages of this happiness, and have been enriched by a magnificent abundance of wealth, and have taken its fruits, they will die at a long age with a good reputation.

<margin>Saturn in Pisces (♓ ♄)</margin>

## JUPITER’S DECREES THROUGH THE INDIVIDUAL
### signs of the Zodiac. Chapter IV.

<margin>Jupiter in Aries (♈).</margin>
If Jupiter is found in Aries (♈), whatever the natives <term>natives: the individuals whose birth charts are being read</term> possess in their early years is disturbed in every action, as long as they fulfill the contraries of the birth chart. But when these times have been completed, then honors, then happy actions, good times, a place for advancement, and the management of the greatest affairs are decreed. Then, furthermore, they are joined in friendship with powerful and great men, or, being established in great and royal houses, the duties of powerful administration are entrusted to them. Then they achieve the greatest patrimonies <term>patrimony: wealth or property inherited from one's father or ancestors</term>, and they receive the power of dominating, and they are relieved by a very great increase of joy from wives or children. Then, finally, powers and the insignia of honor are conferred. Then they obtain the governance and power over men. Then in all cases and legal battles they emerge as victors; and whatever they have considered in silent thought, all of it is completed by the easiest reasoning. For Aries (♈) makes men adorned with the proclamation of goodness, but who have a certain sign <note>original: "signū"—likely a physical mark or mole</note> around the mouth. They will be masters of the estates of others, but religious in the worship of the gods, and observing all precepts with faith, and who may be directed by more powerful men or kings to the duties of great administration, being imperious in all acts, and strong, but whose first times are difficult: afterward, however, shaped by the constant warning of the gods, they may complete all things prosperously, especially if Jupiter himself has looked upon them with a trine aspect <term>trine aspect: 'trigonica radiatione,' a favorable astrological angle of 120 degrees</term> while they are placed in the principal places of the birth chart, and not in the dejected places of Saturn (♄), Mars (♂), the Sun (☉), the Moon (☾), Mercury (☿), or the North Node (☊).

<margin>Taurus (♉)</margin>
If he is found in Taurus (♉), whoever has him thus will be in the greatest glory and power. But after Saturn (♄) has completed his times—since in their first times they were shaken by a heavy storm of dangers, and since they were occupied in sicknesses, slaveries, and legal cases, and furthermore since they have endured contentions with more powerful men, losses, labors, and injuries—then they will have prosperous outcomes of all business, then glories, then they will obtain the friendships of the powerful. Then the powerful will commit the secrets of their lives to them. They will sail on the great sea or on rivers; they will also associate with sterile or infamous men, who are nevertheless devoted to religion. But support for their lives is conferred upon these people by women, and through these women they will achieve the insignia of great dignity and the greatest honors. They will nevertheless be just, strong, and showing love to their friends; and there will be free speech in them, and they will strongly defend their friends. But they will be reckless in every struggle of competition, and strong, and who desire to benefit not themselves, but always their friends. Nevertheless, their friends often turn out to be ungrateful, and they themselves, slipping quite often, are corrected again. They will also be the children of two fathers or two mothers—one by nature, the other by accident <note>original: "per accidens"—referring to adoption or step-parents</note>. But in the beginning they will have joys from wives, and afterward sorrows from children. Likewise, they will benefit many, having the greatest marks of happiness. But Jupiter himself decrees all these things according to the measure of the birth chart.

<margin>Gemini (♊)</margin>
If he is found in Gemini (♊), whoever has him thus will be in the greatest glories and powers, known for their friendships, and always adorned with grace. And although they have sought many things, they lose these same things again, and their goods are varied by constant change. For in the first time of life they will be in dissensions, and in many businesses and losses, in distresses and sicknesses, and they will have constant sorrows concerning their wife and children, until they have completed the forty-fifth year of their age. For within this space of time in the birth chart, they will dissipate whatever they have. But when it has finally come to this time, then they will have reputations, then the support of resources. ## THE DECREES OF MARS THROUGH THE INDIVIDUAL SIGNS
->of the Zodiac. Chapter VI.<-

<margin>Mars in ♈</margin>
If Mars is found in **Aries**, those who have him so will be thieves, loud, fraudulent, and litigious <term>litigious: prone to engaging in lawsuits and legal disputes</term>, always striving to exalt themselves above others. Nevertheless, in their early years, they will attain some happiness; they will be leaders of armies and governors of peoples, always ready for arms, using their bravery or severity to deter others. But this will happen especially when Saturn has first passed the places of the birth chart. Before this time, they will be fickle and entangled in the snares of love—though they will always be adorned with weapons, seeking to strike fear into others and be perpetually revered by them.

<margin>♉</margin>
If Mars is found in **Taurus**, he will make men bold, reckless, and gluttonous <note>original: "obliguritores," literally those who waste money on fine food and delicacies</note>, for whom right and wrong are the same so long as they satisfy their desires. Entangled in the enticements of women, they will frequently stir up quarrels and lawsuits—sometimes even involving homicide—and for this reason, they will be exhausted by much unhappiness. They will also be of a most foul and shameful appearance, continually devoted to jokes and jesting. But as soon as Saturn has completed his first orbit, if they have corrected their deeds and abandoned the habits of their former life, they will be able to rejoice in a better decree for the remainder of their lives.

<margin> Gemini ♊</margin>
If Mars is found in **Gemini**, those who have him so will be dedicated to military service, but they will be the type to devise many stratagems through art and ingenuity in war. They will not be so reckless or bold, but rather those who, with hidden weapons, desire to punish the guilty, investigating their secret crimes with watchful wisdom. They may sometimes attain great marks of honor among kings and princes. But when Saturn has passed through the first places of the birth chart, having become poor and perhaps physically impaired, they will scarcely be able to provide the necessary supports of life for themselves in a sufficient manner.

<margin> Cancer ♋</margin>
If Mars is found in **Cancer**, those who have him so will be horsemen and those who delight in firing ballistae and catapults <term>ballistae: ancient torsion-powered engines used for throwing heavy bolts or stones</term>. They will breed horses and beasts pertaining to military use. They will also be soldiers, occupied with military business, through which they sometimes acquire honor and the fear of other soldiers. They will, however, be of a most foul appearance and strange form, such that everyone mocks them at first. But when Saturn has first passed his orbit, they will turn their attention to the medical faculty—especially surgery—and with great zeal, they will pursue magical incantations and various hidden poisons.

<margin> Leo ♌</margin>
If Mars is found in **Leo**, those who have him so will be powerful, bold, and strong men, who take delight especially in equestrian archery.

<margin>Libra</margin>

<margin>Scorpio</margin>

For before this time they will be poor, envious, hateful, given to evil works, and serving various soldiers; they will also be so devoted to women that, having set aside all honest shame, they may sometimes attempt to bring force upon them, and frequently engage in angry quarrels with them.

<margin>Sagittarius</margin>
If **Mars** is found in **Sagittarius**, whoever has him so will be soft, effeminate, and very lazy and sluggish in their actions, indeed with a feminine voice, weak, and taking joy in feminine finery. But when **Saturn** has passed the first trigon of the birth chart, then they will be bold, strong, magnanimous, and occupied in great business, and they will be easily feared by all for their strength and greatness of spirit. They will nevertheless be daring and joyful, but those who study to perfect their deeds through laws and equity rather than violence, from which they acquire great glory for themselves.

<margin>Capricorn</margin>
If **Mars** is found in **Capricorn**, whoever has him so will be kingly, noble, and powerful men, honored by the greatest trophies and many kinds of victories; they are those who involve themselves chiefly in such business as others would not dare to undertake with such easy reason. But this will be especially so when **Saturn** has passed the second trigon of the birth chart. For before this time, such types of happiness are not so decreed, even though they may always be joined in the friendly company of illustrious men and always apply their minds to arduous matters completely hidden from others.

<margin>Aquarius</margin>
If **Mars** is found in **Aquarius**, whoever has him so will be evil, treacherous, wicked, and fond of lawsuits, attempting to sow dissension and discord among everyone and always instigating others; violating human society, they study to bring constant insults upon men. But when **Saturn** has passed the first decan <term>decan: a subdivision of a zodiac sign covering ten degrees, representing a specific period or influence</term> of the birth chart, then they will devote their efforts to breeding horses, stirring up wars, and attacking enemies. But a little later, they will fall into defects of the limbs and blindness of the eyes, whereby they may be forced to serve others and no longer have any liberty in their lives.

<margin>Pisces</margin>
If **Mars** is found in **Pisces**, whoever has him so will be jesters, pleasure-seekers, and followers of women, who desire to fulfill all delights of both their bodies and minds. They will nevertheless be diviners, prophets, and soothsayers, and those who perform such wondrous things through magical operations that they are honored by everyone for that reason, and even feared by many. These things, however, will be when **Saturn** has passed the second trigon of the birth chart; for before this time, they will be killers of men, and...

## THE DECREES OF THE SUN through the individual 
## signs of the zodiac. Chapter VI.

<margin>The Sun in Aries</margin>
If the **Sun** is found in **Aries**, whoever has him thus will be men of varied fortune. For at one time they are raised up from low estate, and at another time they are cast down from the position of lords and princes to a humble and sad fortune. But these men will especially rejoice in wrong-doing, cruelty, and savage victory. However, as soon as **Saturn** has passed through the first trigon <term>trigon: a group of three zodiac signs belonging to the same element; a 'trinity' of signs</term> of the birth chart, and if the **Sun** is in the cardines <term>cardines: the four 'pivots' or angles of the chart—the Ascendant, Midheaven, Descendant, and Lower Midheaven—which are the strongest points in a horoscope</term> or their succeeding houses <note>original: "anaphoris"</note>, and is not weighed down by the threatening rays of the malevolent planets <note>the malevolent planets are traditionally Saturn and Mars</note>, they will increase their wealth; they will obtain such journeys from princes in which they may seek honor and advantage. But if the Sun is struck by the rays of the malevolent planets, they will suffer evils from kings.

<margin>Taurus</margin>
If the **Sun** is found in **Taurus**, whoever has him thus will be such men who, in order to increase their treasures, will always be engaged in battles; and to satisfy their lust, by which they will be burdened, they will attempt to increase their money in whatever way they can, even through unjust means. But as soon as **Saturn** has completed the first circuit of the birth chart, and if the **Sun** is protected by the favorable rays of the benevolent planets <note>the benevolent planets are traditionally Jupiter and Venus</note>, then they will begin to obtain utility and glory from kings and princes. But if the Sun is weighed down by the threatening rays of the evil planets, they will obtain pains, distresses, and unexpected labors from those same kings.

<margin>Gemini</margin>
If the **Sun** is found in **Gemini**, whoever has him thus will be princes or leading men, but of meager spirit and small power. Yet these men will desire to rule everything according to their own will, adhering to no one’s advice, and for that reason they will lose their reputation and their status. But when **Saturn** has first passed through the trigon of the birth chart, and if the **Sun** is positioned in favorable places and protected by the prosperous rays of the benevolent stars, these men will have a great profit from partnerships, and they will obtain a great joy because of their children; yet the opposite will happen if the malevolent stars hinder the **Sun**.

<margin>Cancer</margin>
If the **Sun** is found in **Cancer**, whoever has him thus will be men chiefly devoted to jesting, songs, games, and storytelling, lovers of beautiful adornment, and those who, because of such pleasures of theirs, utterly despise the reconciliations and fellowships of men. But as soon as **Saturn** has passed through the trigon of the birth chart, then let them fear their enemies; for they will be easily overcome by them, and will be established in many labors. If, however, the **Sun** is positioned in favorable places of the birth chart and is not weighed down by the threatening rays of the malevolent planets, all these evils will be diminished.

<margin>Leo</margin>
If the **Sun** is found in **Leo**, whoever has him thus will be kings, princes, and powerful men, who trust in both arms and their own power, and who desire to utterly overcome everyone and to lord it over all, and to obtain all their wills and desires by whatever means. They will be such that they always bring back utility and profit, with the highest praise from everyone, from all their business. This is especially true if the **Sun** is positioned in favorable places of the birth chart and is entirely free from the evil planets. But when **Saturn** reaches the third trigon of the birth chart, then many sicknesses and pains will befall them.

<margin>Virgo</margin>
If the **Sun** is found in **Virgo**, whoever has him thus will be famous and high-ranking men, endowed with a certain wonderful talent. But they are intent only on games, stories, and jesting; they love feasts, songs, and companionship, and they are free for all delicacies, perfumes, and pleasures; nevertheless, they may attain wealth most abundantly through their talent and learning. This happens especially when **Saturn** has passed through the second trigon of the birth chart, and the **Sun** is protected in favorable places by the protection of the benevolent stars. But if the Sun is struck by the rays of the malevolent planets, they will never be able to fulfill their vows.

<margin>Libra</margin>
If the **Sun** is found in **Libra**, whoever has him thus will be powerful men and princes; but having lost their empire or their happy condition, they may flee as exiles and fugitives, trembling from the sight of their enemies, nor have anyone in whom they can trust or safely commit their lives to the fates. This occurs as soon as **Saturn** has passed through the first trigon of the birth chart and the **Sun** has been weighed down in the chart by the rays of the malevolent planets. For before this time, perhaps in their early age, they will make many journeys, from which they may most happily obtain some glory and profit.

BOOK FIVE. 137

<margin>♌ The Sun in Leo</margin>
If the **Sun** is found in **Leo**, whoever has him thus will be handsome men, with well-proportioned and elegant bodies, of great name and fame, and who take delight in fine clothing. They will also be the sort of men who obtain honor and high regard from kings, acquire many inheritances, and increase their ancestral estate, for which they are feared by others. This is especially true once **Saturn** has passed through the first trigon <term>trigon: a group of three zodiac signs belonging to the same element; here, the Fire signs of Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius</term> of the birth chart. For before this time, they are placed in many labors and partnerships, yet they will obtain the greatest profits from some violent plundering—provided that the malevolent planets <note>the malevolent planets are traditionally Saturn and Mars</note> do not look upon the **Sun** with a threatening aspect.

<margin>♍ The Sun in Virgo</margin>
If the **Sun** is found in **Virgo**, whoever has him thus will be powerful and decorated with great marks of honor. However, they are men who cause much loss to others and, without reason or any sense of equity, strip them bare even unto death through their plundering. Because of this, several sorrows will befall them: the disparagement of many people, anxieties, and sometimes the loss of their children. This occurs especially once **Saturn** has passed through the first trigon of the birth chart and the **Sun** has been weighed down by the threatening aspect of the malevolent planets. For before this time, they will be joyful, sufficiently fortunate, and fertile with very beautiful offspring.

<margin>♎ The Sun in Libra</margin>
If the **Sun** is found in **Libra**, whoever has him thus will be kings of great fame and high renown, who strive to prevent all the evils threatening those of lower status, and will not allow the more powerful to rage against the people. But as soon as **Saturn** has passed through the first trigon of the birth chart, then sicknesses, pains, and sorrows are decreed, as well as a decrease in honor and fame, and the loss of the ancestral estate. For they will become the sort of men who seek out the company of even the lowliest people; being joined in the society of such characters, they perform such deeds that disgrace and infamy follow them in many ways.

<margin>♏ The Sun in Scorpio</margin>
If the **Sun** is found in **Scorpio**, whoever has him thus will be men who command others, yet they will be of modest name and scant fame, having few faithful clients. For these men will be of a stubborn will, demanding things of their servants that often exceed their condition, which is why they find few who are obedient to them. Many anxieties, labors, and illnesses will happen to them and their partners, perhaps for this reason; they will suffer many losses and perhaps even the destruction of their substance as adversaries are stirred up against them. But when **Saturn** has passed through the second trigon of the birth chart, they will devote their efforts to marital affairs <note>original: "rei uxoriae"</note>.

<margin>♐ The Sun in Sagittarius</margin>
If the **Sun** is found in **Sagittarius**, whoever has him thus will be men given to games, jokes, and songs; they are lazy, quiet, idle, and doing nothing, but only following their own desires. They do not weigh the honesty or the shamefulness of their habits, but are of an entirely bad character and a wicked nature. From this, many labors, many losses, and many distresses will often occur, especially when **Saturn** has passed through the second trigon of the birth chart. For before this time, having been adopted only by these delights, they may perhaps obtain good fortune, which they then turn into bad fortune by their own fault.

<margin>Venus in Aries</margin>
If **Venus** is found in **Aries**, whoever has her thus will be sad, worried, and anxious men, flawed in both body and mind, poor and beggars, and those whom many obstacles of various calamities harm. They will also be men of much deliberation and varied wandering, often held by impure love—especially if **Mars** looks upon **Venus** so positioned with any aspect. But when **Saturn** has passed through the second trigon of the birth chart, and if **Venus** is protected by a favorable aspect from **Jupiter**, this bad fortune is somewhat mitigated, and she promises better outcomes thereafter.

<margin>♉ Venus in Taurus</margin>
If **Venus** is found in **Taurus**, whoever has her thus will be noble men of high heart, of great esteem and fame, associates of kings and princes, and perhaps the tutors of royal sons; they are men who always have familiarity with the leading and noble men. This is especially true if a favorable aspect from **Jupiter** looks upon **Venus** when she is positioned in suitable places in the birth chart. But when **Saturn** has passed through the second trigon, several rumors will arise against them, because of which they may lose their acquired fame and suffer the greatest damage to their resources.

<margin>♊ Venus in Gemini</margin>
If **Venus** is found in **Gemini**, whoever has her thus will be good men, having good will toward all, and who, with a certain great fire of piety, strive to help all people, especially the poor and the afflicted. They will also be wise, shrewd, ingenious, eloquent, and of a handsome and delightful appearance...

<margin>♋ Venus in Cancer</margin> If **Venus** is found in **Cancer**, whoever has her thus will be men intent only on feasts, banquets, and social gatherings; they will seek out gems, precious stones, and other such ornaments, being lovers of beautiful clothing. This is especially true if **Jupiter** <note>original: ♃</note> looks upon **Venus**—when she is positioned in favorable places in the birth chart—with a favorable aspect, and when **Saturn** has passed through the second trigon of the birth chart. For before this time, they will be weighed down by several anxieties and labors, through which they will suffer the greatest setbacks in life.

<margin>♌ Venus in Leo</margin> If **Venus** is found in **Leo**, whoever has her thus will be men who are poor, neglected, afflicted in body, and of a diverse and shifting nature. But as soon as **Saturn** has passed through the first trigon <term>the Fire signs: Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius</term> of the birth chart, and **Venus** has been protected by a benign aspect, all these stains are completely diminished. For then, associating mostly with noble men, they both restore their reputation and obtain some assistance for their resources.

<margin>♍ Venus in Virgo</margin> If **Venus** is found in **Virgo**, whoever has her thus will be men who are always sad, anxious, worried, and mournful; afflicted in body and mind, they associate mostly with the needy and the lowest sort of people. This is especially true as soon as **Saturn** has passed through the first trigon of the birth chart, and **Venus** or **Mercury** has been struck by the hostile aspect of the malevolent planets <note>the malevolent planets are traditionally Saturn and Mars</note>. But when **Saturn** has passed through the second trigon, and **Venus** or **Mercury** has been protected by the favorable aspect of the benevolent stars <note>the benevolent stars are Jupiter and Venus</note>, then, with all evils driven out, a second and favorable fortune will eventually begin to blow upon them.

<margin>♎ Venus in Libra</margin> If **Venus** is found in **Libra**, whoever has her thus will be fair and just men, but lovers of legal proceedings or military decorations. Compelled by a cause involving a woman, they are often forced to use arms to drive away opponents, and from this they suffer no small inconveniences of adversity. This happens especially when **Saturn** has passed through the second trigon of the birth chart. For before this time, they will be intent on jokes, games, and songs, and entangled in the loves of women; although they may sometimes incur many labors from these things, they will nevertheless receive very many delights of pleasure.

<margin>♏ Venus in Scorpio</margin> If **Venus** is found in **Scorpio**, whoever has her thus will be choleric <note>easily angered or irritable</note>, litigious, proud, and arrogant in spirit; they are people who always seek out lawsuits, discords, and quarrels, desiring by any means to achieve the desires of their own will. These people, having no respect for honesty or equity, will attempt to violently wrench desired things from the hands of others, and for this reason they will not hesitate at times to stoop even to the killing of men. But as soon as **Saturn** has passed through the first trigon of the birth chart, eventually turning toward the path of equity, they will strive to change the habits of their former life for the better.

<margin>♐ Venus in Sagittarius</margin> If **Venus** is found in **Sagittarius**, whoever has her thus will be javelin-throwers and archers, who take great delight in martial games of this kind. For this reason, they will perhaps be pleasing to noble men, whose constant company they will enjoy. From this, they will be able to acquire some support for their lives, and obtain fame and a glorious name among others. But as soon as **Saturn** has passed through the first trigon of the birth chart, becoming involved in evil and wicked associations, they lose everything they had acquired in their early youth through a wretched tearing-away by infamy and adverse fortune.

<margin>♑ Venus in Capricorn</margin> If **Venus** is found in **Capricorn**, whoever has her thus will be honest, calm, and cheerful men; lovers of jokes, songs, and social circles. They will be of good stature and handsome appearance, taking delight mostly in banquets and loving beautiful things and ornaments. This is especially true once **Saturn** has passed through the first trigon of the birth chart. For before this time, they will be joined mostly to shameful people, from whom they obtain disgrace rather than infamy—especially if **Saturn** looks upon **Venus** with a threatening and hostile aspect while she is positioned in weakened places of the birth chart.

<margin>♒ Venus in Aquarius</margin> If **Venus** is found in **Aquarius**, those who have her thus will be men devoted only to bird-catching and hunting; but in other matters they are lazy, sluggish, idle, and melancholy, and who [possess] no...

### THE DECREES OF MERCURY THROUGH THE INDIVIDUAL
### signs of the Zodiac. Chapter VIII.

<margin>♈ Mercury in Aries</margin> **I**f **Mercury** is found in **Aries**, whoever has it thus will be evil, litigious, brawlers, contentious, murderers, and those who always try to oppose everyone craftily and insidiously with various outcries; for that reason, they frequently come into the greatest losses and calamities. But when **Saturn** has passed the second trigon of the birth chart, and if **Mercury** has been fortified by the favorable radiation of benevolent stars, they are forced to lay aside some of their former ferocity, from which they can prepare some friends for themselves and obtain the necessary supports of life.

<margin>♉ Mercury in Taurus</margin> If **Mercury** is found in **Taurus**, those who have it thus will be jesters, singers, and those who delight in games, stories, banquets, and gluttony; they will be sluggish, slow, idle, and devoted only to the belly and pleasures. Yet they will be clever, ingenious, and sagacious, executing many things by the power of their ingenuity. But when **Saturn** has passed the second trigon of the birth chart, and if **Mercury** has been hindered by the rays of malevolent stars, then labors, then anxieties, then many inconveniences are decreed, from which many losses come to them.

<margin>♊ Mercury in Gemini</margin> If **Mercury** is found in **Gemini**, whoever has it thus will be men of sharp sense, ingenious, and sagacious, but always prone to evil; they are those who always adapt their eloquence and industry to lawsuits, brawls, dissensions, and discords. But when **Saturn** has passed the second trigon of the birth chart, then losses and detriments, then calamities and wants are decreed: and this especially in the hebdomadic <term>hebdomadic: referring to the seven-year cycles of life</term> or enneatic <term>enneatic: referring to the nine-year cycles of life</term> years, in which they will sometimes come to such a want of things that they are forced to miserably beg for the necessary supports of life from others.

<margin>♋ Mercury in Cancer</margin> If **Mercury** is found in **Cancer**, whoever has it thus will be sad, solicitous, and anxious men, occupied daily in many thoughts: yet they will be crafty, astute, clever, caviling <note>original: "cauillosi," meaning fond of trivial objections</note>, and full of pain and snares, with which they always try to falsely attack and overcome others. They will also be given to evil works, from which they frequently incur great infamy and detriments. But when **Saturn** has passed the second trigon of the birth chart, having laid aside evil character and deceitful works, they will be converted to a better life and will enjoy for a while the favorable decree of fortune.

<margin>♌ Mercury in Leo</margin> If **Mercury** is found in **Leo**, whoever has it thus will be soldiers, especially giving their effort to military matters; they will love wars and battles, in which they will be most powerful, whence they will attain honor and glory for themselves with the greatest utility. They will also be so greedy for victory that they often try to violently seize it from the hands of enemies beyond equity and justice. But when **Saturn** has passed the second trigon of the birth chart, they will be led into some pains and labors, from which they perceive the greatest impediments of life, especially if **Mercury** has been hindered by the rays of malevolent stars.

<margin>♍ Mercury in Virgo</margin> If **Mercury** is found in **Virgo**, whoever has it thus will be strong, industrious, and sagacious; they will be breeders of horses, hawks, falcons, and other birds belonging to fowling; similarly of dogs, mastiffs, and greyhounds, and those suited for hunting. They will also maintain men and soldiers, and all the defenses... <note>The text cuts off mid-word "munimenta" (defenses/fortifications) at the page break.</note>

For then, associated with powerful men, they will obtain some benefits of honors and resources. But before this time, hindered by some labors and anxieties, they will be constantly exhausted.

<margin>♐ Mercury in Sagittarius</margin> In **Sagittarius**, if he is found, whoever has him thus will be evil men, litigants, murderers, always prepared for dissension and discord, and those who for the most part delight in arms and all the protection of weapons; they serve neither laws nor justice, but are always hostile to judges and their officials. This is especially true as soon as **Saturn** has passed the first trigon of the birth chart, and **Mars** <note>original: ♂</note> is set against him or weakened in opposition <note>original: ☍</note>. For before this time they will not be so evil, although they may be associated with gatherings of wicked people, which makes them worse.

<margin>♑ Mercury in Capricorn</margin> In **Capricorn**, if he is found, whoever has him thus will be poor, weak, low-born, stripped of all resources, sickly in health, impaired in their limbs, and continuously exhausted by long labors and the obstacles of life; and this is especially so if no benevolent star looks upon **Mercury** with a favorable radiation. But when **Saturn** has first passed the first trigon of the birth chart, and he is aided by the favorable rays of **Jupiter**, **Saturn**, or **Venus** <note>original: ♀</note>, being somewhat relieved from such great calamities, they will seek a few things and the meager supports of life, through which they may live miserably until death.

<margin>♒ Mercury in Aquarius</margin> In **Aquarius**, if he is found, whoever has him thus will be astronomers, augurs, fortune-tellers, magicians, accountants, interpreters of dreams, and those who, moved by a certain divine frenzy <note>original: "divino quodam furore," a state of prophetic inspiration</note>, predict future things to the nations; from this they may obtain both a name among the people and many supports for their life. They will also be the sort who always labor in the investigation of hidden things, treasures, metals, and other secrets. But when **Saturn** has passed the second trigon of the birth chart, being occupied with these matters to the greatest extent, they will fall into some obstacles in life.

<margin>♓ Mercury in Pisces</margin> In **Pisces**, if he is found, whoever has him thus will be handsome, sharp, intelligent, and most just observers of laws and judgments, of charming appearance, well-composed in body and limbs, greatly enjoying ornate clothing, eloquent, articulate, and learned in many sciences. For this reason they are honored by everyone, from whom they seek many supports for their resources; and this is especially true if **Jupiter** looks upon **Mercury** thus positioned with a favorable radiation. But when **Saturn** has passed the second trigon of the birth chart, then being occupied with some disturbances, they will come into several obstacles of life.

# JULIUS FIRMICUS MATERNUS

...idle, and those who have absolutely no care for their affairs or their authority. These people will also be of no thought or direction, especially in their own business, from which at times the greatest impediments to life arise. But if **Saturn** <note>original: ♄</note> should pass through the first trigon <term>trigon: a grouping of three zodiac signs of the same element; here used to mark a specific phase of life</term> of the birth chart, then they will suffer many losses, many detriments, and adversities from the poor consideration of their affairs; then, finally, they will at times run into the greatest calamities.

<margin>☽ Moon</margin>
If the **Moon** <note>original: ☽</note> is found [in her own sign, Cancer], whoever has her thus will be noble, wealthy, and powerful, of high name, and of great esteem and fame; beautiful, charming, graceful; and in all limbs and the whole body, composed with a certain delightful proportion; rejoicing in ornate garments and delicate finery. For this reason, they are loved by many and even venerated by most: especially if **Jupiter** <note>original: ♃</note> looks upon the Moon so positioned with a prosperous radiation <note>original: "radiatione," an astrological aspect or beam of influence</note>. This, however, is determined most especially at that time when **Saturn** <note>original: ♄</note> has passed through the first trigon of the birth chart. For before this time, hindered by certain labors and disturbances, they fall into the greatest distresses, from which they will nevertheless later be relieved.

<margin>♒︎ Aquarius</margin>
If she [the Moon] is found in **Aquarius**, whoever has her thus will be wanderers, fugitives, outcasts, and those who for the most part pursue fugitives; never resting, but always established in continuous motion. These people will also be devoted to fowling and hunting, from which they nevertheless perceive no utility, or very little; and they will attempt to do those things especially from which they can follow no profit at all. In the seven-year <note>original: "hebdomaticis"</note> or nine-year <note>original: "enneaticis"</note> cycles, they will suffer even greater impediments of life. But when **Saturn** <note>original: ♄</note> has passed through the second trigon of the birth chart, then for the sake of women or wives, they will be able to find some comforts of life and rest in some place.

<margin>♓︎ Pisces</margin>
If she [the Moon] is found in **Pisces**, whoever has her thus will be humble and abject, poor, despised, covered in clothes and rags, and utterly like slaves; idle, sluggish, of no thoughts; yet hunters, fowlers, and gamblers, and those who are always entangled in pleasures of this kind. But this will be especially when **Saturn** <note>original: ♄</note> has passed through the second trigon of the birth chart: for before this time, they will perhaps enjoy a better decree. These, [Lollianus] **Mavortius** <note>The Roman senator to whom Firmicus dedicated this work</note>, our glory, are the decrees of the individual stars in each of the signs: which, if you examine them compared to one another with a sound judgment of mind, you will be able to explain the substance of human fates by indubitable prophecy. Now we must say what the individual stars decree in their own and others' boundaries <term>boundaries: also known as "terms," specific degrees within a sign ruled by different planets</term>.

### boundaries of others, and first Saturn. Chapter 10.

<margin>Saturn in his own places.</margin>
If **Saturn** <note>original: ♄</note> is found in his own house <note>Capricorn or Aquarius</note> or his own decan <term>decan: a 10-degree subdivision of a zodiac sign</term>, and it is a daytime birth, he will make men who always seek the friendship of noble men, and of kings and princes, joined to them by constant conversation of business and habit. If, being so positioned, he is found in the **horoscope** <term>horoscope: here meaning the Ascendant, the sign rising on the eastern horizon</term>, and the **Place of Fortune** <term>Place of Fortune: a calculated point in the chart representing prosperity</term> is joined to it in equal association, he decrees the greatest faculty of substance <note>meaning wealth or resources</note>. If, however, it is a nighttime birth, he provides a multitude of labors and sicknesses.

<margin>♃ Jupiter</margin>
If **Saturn** <note>original: ♄</note> is found in the house or decan of **Jupiter** <note>original: ♃</note>, and it is a daytime birth, he decrees a happy state, an abundance of substance, and a multitude of honors. If, however, it is a nighttime birth, he decrees discordant enmities and contentions with noble men and the leaders of the city; he also threatens the mournful death of the father.

<margin>♂ Mars</margin>
If **Saturn** <note>original: ♄</note> is found in the house or decan of **Mars** <note>original: ♂</note>, both in a daytime and a nighttime birth, he makes men harsh, crude, severe, and those who are never moved by any inclination of piety or mercy; also grave, wrathful, and often thinking many things both in their own deeds and those of others; difficult indeed, intractable, proud, and insolent: but who may win the close friendships and necessities of princes similar to themselves, and especially of soldiers.

<margin>☉ Sun</margin>

## OF THE OTHER PLANETS. Chapter XI.

<margin>Jupiter in his own places</margin>
If **Jupiter** <note>original: ♃</note> is found in his own house or decan, and it is a day birth, it makes men fortunate, wealthy, honored, and those upon whom the greatest insignias of honor are conferred—provided that no malevolent star looks upon him with a threatening radiation <note>original: "radiatione," an astrological aspect or beam of influence</note>. It also makes them pleasing and beloved to princes, and those who are preferred for some magisterial honor among them. If, however, it is a night birth, it diminishes something from this happy decree and causes them to be exhausted by some labors.

<margin>♄ Saturn</margin>
If **Jupiter** <note>original: ♃</note> is found in the house or decan of **Saturn** <note>original: ♄</note>, in both a day and night birth, it makes men wealthy and affluent, but those who achieve absolutely no insignias of honor or any name. Rather, it will make them the sort who, although they possess much substance, nevertheless pretend to be poor; they care for no reputation nor praise, according to the condition of their lineage. They will be narrow-hearted and greedy for gain, for the sake of which they consider neither labors nor even shameful deeds, from which they more often encounter bad consequences.

<margin>♂ Mars</margin>
If **Jupiter** <note>original: ♃</note> is found in the house or decan of **Mars** <note>original: ♂</note> in either birth chart, it makes leaders of armies and great soldiers, especially if he is positioned in the angles <term>cardines: the four pivotal points of a chart—the Ascendant, Midheaven, Descendant, and Lower Midheaven</term> or their succedents <term>anaphoris: houses that "follow" the angles, often indicating the middle stages of life</term>, and in masculine signs. It will also make astronomers <note>original: "astronomos"; in this period, the study of the physical movements of stars and their influence on humans were considered parts of the same discipline</note> and those who explore the courses of the stars, for which reason they are sometimes granted some insignias of dignity. This is especially true if the **Sun** <note>original: ☉</note> or **Moon** <note>original: ☽</note>, positioned in the angles of the birth chart, look upon them with a benevolent radiation and confirm it by their decree.

<margin>☉ Sun</margin>
If **Jupiter** <note>original: ♃</note> is found in the house or decan of the **Sun** <note>original: ☉</note>, and it is a day birth, it will make men wise, of good character, pleasing to princes and the people, and those who, through their wisdom and integrity, confer many benefits upon the state. If, joined in such a partnership, he is positioned in the angles of the birth chart or their succedents, he will perhaps render them as those who, decorated with royal power, are either kings themselves or the deputies of kings and princes. If it is a night birth, something of such happiness is diminished.

<margin>♀ Venus</margin>
If **Jupiter** <note>original: ♃</note> is found in the house or decan of **Venus** <note>original: ♀</note>, and it is a day birth, it makes men honored in the houses of princes, and those who either handle their counsels or collect taxes, from which they acquire the greatest benefits for themselves. ## THE DECREES OF MARS IN THE BOUNDS OF OTHER PLANETS. Chapter XII.

<margin>Mars in his own places.</margin>
If **Mars** <note>original: ♂</note> is found in his own house or decan, in both daytime and nocturnal birth charts, it will make men proud, bold, cruel, and irritable, and those who strive to bring all the concepts of their mind to completion. They will also be ferocious, reckless, impetuous, and adorned with no sense of piety or religion, but rather driven mad by a certain license of their own recklessness.

<margin>Saturn ♄</margin>
If **Mars** is found in the house or decan of **Saturn** <note>original: ♄</note>, in both daytime and nocturnal birth charts, it will make men handsome, swift, and agile in running, and as easy-going as they are industrious in all their works; yet they will be melancholic and seekers of hidden things, such as treasures, tombs, gold, silver, hidden metals, and finally all things that are foreign to the common customs of men. Their younger brothers, however, by the fatal decree of the stars, will destroy their own substance.

<margin>Jupiter ♃</margin>
If **Mars** is found in the house or decan of **Jupiter** <note>original: ♃</note>, similarly in either birth chart, it will make men noble, great, and high-minded, joined by the close society and goodwill of kings and princes, achieving from them not only the greatest marks of honor, but also the means of supporting their lives. But if **Jupiter** is positioned in the house of **Mars**, or regards it with a benevolent alignment, it will make them noble leaders of an army and of many military campaigns, from which they may achieve the greatest name and glory for themselves.

<margin>Sun ☉</margin>
