For if dangers were decreed in the **birth chart** <term>genitura; the individual's natal horoscope</term> by [Saturn] himself, then he carries out whatever he had previously decreed. If he decrees **childlessness** <note>original: "orbitatem"</note> in the birth chart, then he pursues the wretched offspring of children with cruel power. If he has decreed **widowhood**, then he dissolves the marriage either by death or by discord. If accusations, then he stirs up crowds of enemies; if illnesses, then he inflicts the vice of wretched calamity; if losses, then he shakes the inheritance with various manglings. But if he was well-placed, and decrees something prosperous in the birth chart, having followed the power of his own condition, then he restores whatever he previously promised, especially if, being well-placed himself, he regards the lord of the birth chart in a **daytime birth** <note>In ancient astrology, charts were interpreted differently depending on whether the Sun was above or below the horizon</note>.

¶ From his own time, **Saturn** ♄ assigns **12 months** to himself, if he has been made the lord of the times. But if Saturn is badly placed in the birth chart, and through him either danger, sickness, loss, or misfortune has been decreed, then all threats of danger are mitigated by the power of a **salutary god** <note>referring here to Jupiter, the "Great Benefic"</note>. But if **Jupiter** ♃, being well-situated in the birth chart, decrees the times, he bestows increases of the greatest happiness, especially if it is a daytime birth and he is placed in good signs or degrees, and is joined by a **trine** △ and happy radiation.

¶ From his ten-year period, **Saturn** ♄ assigns **15 months**, if he has been made the lord of the times. But when **Mars** ♂ receives the time assigned to him by Saturn, all malice having been lulled to sleep, he decrees the joy of a happy time. For they mitigate each other in turn from the opposing powers of their virtues.

**Saturn** ♄ assigns **19 months** from his ten-year period to the **Sun** ☉, if he has been made the lord of the times. But when the **Sun** ☉ receives the time assigned to him by Saturn, he stirs up legal cases and contentious struggles in litigation. But these cases for the most part are brought regarding the ownership of houses or foundations, especially if it is a **nighttime birth**; but he also decrees danger for the father and causes a loss of dignity.

**Saturn** ♄ assigns **eight months** from his ten-year period to **Venus** ♀, if he has been made the lord of the times. But when **Venus** ♀ receives the time assigned to her by Saturn, she separates it from all misfortune, so that it is corrected by a salutary remedy from any preceding crisis which the malice of another star might have perpetrated. But if he [Saturn] himself decrees a marriage, then a **widow** is joined as a wife in the nuptial bond.

**Saturn** ♄ assigns **15 months** from his ten-year period to **Mercury** ☿, if he has been made the lord of the times. But when **Mercury** ☿ receives the time assigned to him by Saturn, he rouses the lulled animosities of old cases, and will cause the hidden insults of contentions to be brought forward and stirred up again with revived legal actions.

**Saturn** ♄ assigns **25 months** from his ten-year period to the **Moon** ☾, if he has been made the lord of the times. But when the **Moon** ☾ receives the time assigned to her by Saturn, she will stir up illnesses from **corrupt humors** <note>The four bodily fluids—blood, phlegm, yellow bile, and black bile—thought to control health</note>, or will strike with the greatest crisis of danger from water, or will cause one to be troubled by the announcement of new lawsuits, so that this whole time always induces various dangers and various anxieties. But this is if the **Moon** ☾ is full of light; if however she is waning, and in the birth chart is struck by the radiation of **Saturn** ♄, he decrees the disadvantages of a most unhappy death along with wretched calamities.

## THE DECREES OF JUPITER, WHEN HE
### IS THE LORD OF THE TIMES. Chapter XXXV.

If **Jupiter** ♃ has been made the lord of the times—that is, when the order of times has come to him—ten years and nine months are also assigned to him. But this whole time is divided by him in a similar fashion. Therefore, he himself must also be inspected when he is lord, to see how he is positioned in the birth chart, and in which signs and degrees he is located; and whether he is situated in the first or second **pivots** <term>cardines; the four most powerful houses of the chart (1st, 10th, 7th, 4th)</term>, or truly in the **idle and cast down** <note>original: "pigris, atq; deiectis"</note> houses; and whether it is a daytime birth or a nighttime one. For from all these things, when he is the lord of the times, we shall find the efficacy of his decrees. For whatever was decreed by **Jupiter** ♃ in the birth chart, he restores when he has acquired the lordship of the times. But you ought to observe this in all the other stars as well, whatever we have said about **Saturn** ♄. For all stars, whatever they have decreed in the birth chart, whether it be prosperous or evil, will carry it out completely when they have obtained the lordship of the times.

To **Jupiter** ♃, therefore, since ten years and nine months have been assigned, he himself first claims **twelve months** for himself out of all this time. In these 12 months, which **Jupiter** ♃ has thus assigned to himself, he decrees the glory of happiness and joys, according to the measure of the birth chart;

He also grants glories and honors, and increases of the inheritance, as we have said, according to the measure of the birth chart.

**Jupiter** ♃ assigns **30 months** from his ten-year period to **Saturn** ♄, if he has been made the lord of the times. But when Saturn receives the time assigned to him from Jupiter, he makes men always be dulled by sluggish behavior, so that in all actions they fail due to the inert numbness of cold <note>The "cold" of Saturn was thought to cause depression, lethargy, or physical paralysis</note>: this occurs, however, if it is a **nocturnal birth** <note>original: "nocturna genitura"</note>, and if Saturn is not well-placed in the birth chart.

**Jupiter** ♃ assigns **15 months** from his ten-year period to **Mars** ♂, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Mars receives the time assigned to him from Jupiter, he changes the whole order of life and business: and whatever is managed in the previous arrangement of business, he transfers to another order of life, so that in this time the establishments of the previous office are abandoned, or certainly he will cause harm through various dangers.

**Jupiter** ♃ assigns **19 months** from his ten-year period to the **Sun** ☉, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when the Sun receives the time assigned to him from Jupiter, he makes all the secrets of life be made public, and converts all actions by various means; he also leads the mind through various kinds of anxieties with diverse thoughts: he even dissipates whatever was composed before, so that with everything disturbed and confused, the mind is divided through various kinds of anxieties: but these things are diminished in a **daytime birth** <note>original: "diurna genitura"</note>.

**Jupiter** ♃ assigns **8 months** from his ten-year period to **Venus** ♀, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Venus receives the time assigned to her from Jupiter, if she is the mistress of a nocturnal birth, either Jupiter himself brings about marriages, or he decrees prosperous times with the benefit of happiness. In a daytime birth, however, he imposes moderate and constant enticements of love, especially if Venus herself has moved the nature of the place or sign, or has changed her own nature.

**Jupiter** ♃ assigns **20 months** from his ten-year period to **Mercury** ☿, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Mercury receives the time assigned to him from Jupiter, he decrees such acts from which the greatest benefits of profit are conferred, and he grants the protection of many and great friendships, and in all duties he assigns increases of prosperous reason, so that from all acts prosperous benefits of both profit and happiness are conferred with favorable fortune.

**Jupiter** ♃ assigns **25 months** from his ten-year period to the **Moon** ☽, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when the Moon receives the time assigned to her from Jupiter, he decrees the rest of tranquil serenity and the greatest increases of happiness: but this is according to the substance of the birth chart. For then the pain of previous misfortunes is mitigated by various kinds of consolations: then the narrow straits of poverty are relaxed, then health restrains the vices of illnesses, then the fear of dangers is opposed by prosperous protections, then in all contests for various causes, judgments are brought forth according to one’s wishes, then pain is broken, then anxiety is changed, so that with the squalor of previous misfortunes wiped away, a pure and clean time of happiness approaches, especially if Jupiter looks upon a **full Moon** <note>original: "Lunam plenam luminibus"</note> with a prosperous **aspect** <term>radiatione; the way planets "look" at each other across the zodiac</term> in the birth chart.

## THE DECREES OF MARS, WHEN HE HAS BECOME THE LORD OF THE TIMES. Chapter 36.

If **Mars** ♂ has been made the lord of the times, or when he comes to the lordship of the ten-year period, all this time is divided by him also by the same methods; and in this likewise, just as with Saturn ♄ and Jupiter ♃, you ought to inspect everything by a similar method: namely, the sign, the degree, the condition, the place, and the testimonies, so that you may be able to find and judge everything through clear investigations.

Mars, therefore, when he is the lord of the times from his ten-year period, retains **15 months** for himself, in which he decrees indeed the greatest acts, according to the substance of the birth chart: but he decrees them with a prior disturbance, so that in those acts, of whatever kind they may be, various crises of dangers arise, especially if he was the lord of a daytime birth.

**Mars** ♂ assigns **30 months** from his ten-year period to **Saturn** ♄, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Saturn receives the time assigned to him from Mars, he imposes a sluggish weight of slowness in all dealings, so that all business is always conducted more slowly,

**Mars** ♂ assigns **12 months** from his ten-year period to **Jupiter** ♃, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Jupiter receives the time assigned to him from Mars, he decrees all the benefits of prosperity and will always cause business to be completed with a successful outcome: he also bestows gains and all duties of affairs, and grants rest to those laboring, health to the sick, security to the anxious, return to those wandering, an end to those litigating, and abundance to those set in narrow straits.

**Mars** ♂ assigns **19 months** from his ten-year period to the **Sun** ☉, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when the Sun receives the time assigned to him from Mars, he decrees the greatest risks of dangers from constant calamity, and disturbs the entire order of life with a wretched change. He also excites disturbances, moves seditions, and induces pains of the eyes with the greatest continuation of sickness. He also shakes the whole of life with the greatest dangers and incursions of losses. And these will be unavoidable dangers, unless good Jupiter ♃ and a benign **testimony** <term>testimonium; an astrological aspect or "witnessing" by another planet</term> resists them.

**Mars** ♂ assigns **eight months** from his ten-year period to **Venus** ♀, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Venus receives the time assigned to her from Mars, she indeed makes the time prosperous and separated from every risk of dangers: but from the intercourse with many women, infamy is always brought in during those same months. But if they were in **square aspect** <term>quadrati; an aspect of 90 degrees, usually indicating tension</term> to each other in the **birth chart** <term>genitura; the natal horoscope</term>, then they cause adulteries to be committed: but they hide this crime with the testimony of Jupiter; with **Mercury** ☿ and the **Sun** ☉, however, they cause it to be made public, even with a wretched risk to life.

**Mars** ♂ assigns **twenty months** from his ten-year period to **Mercury** ☿, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Mercury receives the time assigned to him from Mars, he will cause dangers to be stirred up from certain writings, or will always inflict wretched loss from some theft: but he will cause enemies to be scattered by frequent reckonings. But if they were in **square aspect** or **opposition** <term>diametri; an aspect of 180 degrees</term> to each other in the birth chart, then they indicate a charge of sorcery or the money of adulterers, especially if Mercury was found in the **terms** <term>finibus; specific subdivisions of a zodiac sign</term> or house of **Saturn** ♄.

**Mars** ♂ assigns **25 months** from his ten-year period to the **Moon** ☽, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when the Moon receives the time assigned to her from Mars, she will always cause the greatest risks of dangers to be brought in, especially if she was full of light <note>The Full Moon was often considered more intense or volatile in these systems</note>. For then dangerous spaces of time are decreed: then flights, then exiles, then wretched risks of dangers are stirred up, then men are thrust into custody or a public prison: then fires, then fevers, then heavy loss, with a wretched tearing apart of marriage is decreed: then a heavy fall of sicknesses is always brought. But if in the birth chart they were in square aspect or opposition with the testimony of Jupiter, then without doubt they cause either a bloody, or a lamentable, or a sudden death. But if Saturn ♄ was found with the Moon in the birth chart, and the Moon receives the time assigned to her from Mars, even then the destructions of a bitter death are brought in from the preceding dangers, which dangers nevertheless obtain their outcome from the varieties of the signs.

## THE DECREES OF THE SUN, WHEN HE IS THE LORD OF TIMES.
### Chapter XXXVII.

If the **Sun** ☉ has been made the lord of the times, you ought to observe all things in him just as we have said for the others, by a similar reasoning, namely the mixtures, temperaments, sign, place, and degrees, so that from the comparison of all these you may find the whole order of the decrees: but also from him all this time, which has been allotted, will be divided by similar reasonings.

Therefore, when the Sun ☉ has been made the lord of the times, he retains **19 months** for himself from his ten-year period. Therefore, in these 19 months, we ought to expect nothing prosperous from him, but all kinds of misfortunes, which nevertheless are mitigated in some part in a **diurnal birth** <term>diurna genitura; a birth occurring during the day</term>, and are put to rest by the testimony of Jupiter ♃, but are raised up [worsened] by Saturn ♄ and Mars ♂, especially if he himself was badly placed in the person's birth chart.

**The Sun** ☉ assigns **30 months** from his ten-year period to **Saturn** ♄, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Saturn receives the time assigned to him from the Sun, in a **nocturnal birth** <term>nocturna genitura; a birth occurring at night</term> he indeed threatens a pestilential and deadly end, but in a diurnal birth he decrees increases of the greatest happiness:

**Jupiter** ♃ assigns **twelve months** from its ten-year period to the **Sun** ☉, if he has been made the lord of the times. **Mercury** ☿ assigns **twenty months** from its ten-year period to the **Sun** ☉, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Mercury receives the time assigned to him from the Sun, he decrees much business, frequent actions, and steady benefits of profit: but these are things acquired with the greatest labors and dangers.

The **Moon** ☽ assigns **twenty-five months** from its ten-year period to the **Sun** ☉, if she has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when the Moon receives the time assigned to her from the Sun, she always disturbs the whole life of the man with stable variety <note>meaning a consistent state of change or fluctuation</note>, so that whatever was gathered in a former time is taken away again for more powerful reasons; and the time itself will be changeable due to various inequality, so that hardships are relieved by sudden riches, and poverty's hardships follow those same riches again.

## THE DECREES OF VENUS WHEN
### she is the mistress of the times. Chapter XXXVIII.

To **Venus** ♀ also, spaces of ten years and nine months are granted. When Venus is the mistress of the times, you ought to examine everything in her with the same reasoning that we have shown should be observed in the others. Therefore, from this whole time, she claims only **eight months** for herself, in which she raises up marital affections with the greatest grace of beauty: but she also decrees joy with the highest security, especially if she was the mistress of that same birth chart.

**Saturn** ♄ assigns **thirty months** from its ten-year period to **Venus** ♀, if she has been made the mistress of the times. Therefore, when Saturn receives the time assigned to him from Venus, he either carries out grave disagreements with a woman through his own indignation, or separates [the man] from his wife, either by death or by certain rivalries.

**Jupiter** ♃ assigns **twelve months** from its ten-year period to **Venus** ♀, if she has been made the mistress of the times. Therefore, when Jupiter receives the time assigned to him from Venus, he decrees a time that is indeed good and joyful, but he will stir up certain infamies <note>original: *infamias*; public disgrace or loss of reputation</note> during it.

**Mars** ♂ assigns **15 months** from its ten-year period to **Venus** ♀, if she has been made the mistress of the times. When Mars receives the time assigned to him from Venus, he decrees many evils and frequent inconveniences of pains. Then he also always agitates the mind with various enticements of love, and because of the harsh torments of love, he always imposes a heavy pain on the spirit, so that because of these vices of an erring mind, risks of lawsuits also frequently occur. Troubles also and dangers on account of very bad wives are either brought by them, or the crime of adultery arises, or a certain love conceived with impure and dishonest thought.

**The Sun** ☉ assigns **19 months** from its ten-year period to **Venus** ♀, if she has been made the mistress of the times. Therefore, when the Sun receives the time assigned to him from Venus, he will make men always flee their own wives, and this with danger to their lives and the loss of their inheritance. If, however, a prosperous **aspect** <term>radius; the "ray" or geometric relationship between planets</term> of Jupiter ♃ approaches, they are separated only by the necessities of travel.

**Mercury** ☿ assigns **20 months** from its own ten-year period to **Venus** ♀, if she has been made the lord of the times <note>In this system, each planet "owns" a certain number of months which it contributes to the major period of whichever planet is currently the "time-lord."</note>. Therefore, when Mercury receives the time assigned to him by Venus, he will cause all business to be completed with a prosperous outcome. He also decrees frequent joys of happiness, causes the greatest profits to be brought in, and happily provides suitable resources of wealth.

The **Moon** ☽ assigns **25 months** from its own ten-year period to **Venus** ♀, if she has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when the Moon receives the time assigned to her by Venus, she indicates a hidden screeching <note>Latin: *stridorem*; likely referring to internal mental friction or anxiety</note> of the spirit. ### THE DECREES OF MERCURY WHEN HE IS THE
### lord of the times. Chapter XXXIX.

To **Mercury** ☿ also, spaces of ten years and nine months are granted. In this case, we must gather everything by a similar reasoning as with the other stars. Therefore, when he himself has been made the lord of the times, he reserves **20 months** for himself from his ten-year period, in which he decrees all good things from steady happiness, and ensures that a prosperous outcome follows all actions—especially if he is the lord of the birth chart and is well-positioned within that chart.

**Saturn** ♄ assigns **30 months** from its ten-year period to **Mercury** ☿, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Saturn receives the time assigned to him by Mercury, he decrees the deaths of those in the household from a steady calamity of misfortunes, such as parents, relatives, patrons, and those who were accustomed to being of use to us.

**Jupiter** ♃ assigns **12 months** from its ten-year period to **Mercury** ☿, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Jupiter receives the time assigned to him by Mercury, he certainly decrees quiet days, separated from all the noise of business; and in this very quiet, he always provides the greatest benefits of praise and joys of happiness. He also grants children to those who do not have them, if the logic of the birth chart permits it.

**Mars** ♂ assigns **15 months** from its ten-year period to **Mercury** ☿, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Mars receives the time assigned to him by Mercury, he will stir up enemies, bring accusations, and decree lawsuits from new denunciations—which, however, a good testimony from Jupiter mitigates.

The **Sun** ☉ assigns **19 months** from its ten-year period to **Mercury** ☿, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when the Sun receives the time assigned to him by Mercury, he always indicates the greatest losses of inheritance and the greatest anxieties in the spirit.

**Venus** ♀ assigns **8 months** from its ten-year period to **Mercury** ☿, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Venus receives the time assigned to her by Mercury, she decrees good benefits from steady happiness: security also, perfect quiet, and—according to the measure of the birth chart—convenient profits.

The **Moon** ☽ assigns **25 months** from its ten-year period to **Mercury** ☿, if he has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when the Moon receives the time assigned to her by Mercury, she decrees the greatest illnesses and the greatest vices of weakness—but these are according to the nature of the place and the zodiac sign, unless Jupiter has mitigated them with a good testimony.

### THE DECREES OF THE MOON WHEN SHE IS THE
### lady of the times. Chapter XL.

To the **Moon** ☽ also, spaces of ten years and nine months are granted. In this, as in all the other stars, you must handle everything with diligent reasoning. Therefore, from this ten-year period, the Moon reserves **25 months** for herself. In these months, if she is so positioned that she is carried toward Saturn while her light is diminishing, or toward Mars while she is full, she decrees death in every way. If, however, she is full of light and adorned by the testimonies of benevolent stars, she decrees moderate increases of inheritance, though only with the greatest labors. For the periods of the Sun ☉ and Moon ☽ always have bad endings, especially if the malevolent stars look upon them with a threatening and unfortunate radiation <note>referring to an astrological aspect or "glance" from a planet like Mars or Saturn</note>.

**Saturn** ♄ assigns **30 months** from its ten-year period to the **Moon** ☽, if she has been made the lady of the times. Therefore, when Saturn receives the time assigned to him by the Moon, if the Moon is waning <note>original: *minuta*; small or diminishing in light</note>, he decrees wretched deaths and wretched endings of dangers from faulty humors <note>referring to the four bodily fluids—blood, phlegm, yellow bile, and black bile—which were believed to cause disease if unbalanced</note>, or from water, or from shipwrecks. If, however, she is full, he indeed does these same things, but gives the possibility of escaping.

**Jupiter** ♃ assigns **twelve months** from its own ten-year period to the **Moon** ☽, if she has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Jupiter receives the time assigned to him by the Moon, he decrees all good things with joy and cheerfulness, especially if the Moon is full of light. For then dangers, fears, and sicknesses are put to rest; then, according to the measure of the birth chart <term>genitura; the individual's natal horoscope</term>, increases in happiness proceed, and adverse matters turn toward prosperity.

**Mars** ♂ assigns **fifteen months** from its own ten-year period to the **Moon** ☽, if she has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Mars receives the time assigned to him by the Moon, if the Moon is full, he decrees the greatest disturbances and seditions; and if in the birth chart he is seen in a square or diameter <note>original: "quadrata uel diametra"; referring to the 90-degree and 180-degree astrological aspects, which were traditionally considered difficult or hostile</note> aspect to Mars, he decrees a bloody outcome of calamity.

The **Sun** ☉ assigns **nineteen months** from its own ten-year period to the **Moon** ☽, if she has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when the Sun receives the time assigned to him by the Moon, he indicates fires, burnings, sicknesses, and the miserable exhaustion of burning fevers; but a favorable testimony from Jupiter will mitigate all these things.

**Venus** ♀ assigns **eight months** from its own ten-year period to the **Moon** ☽, if she has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Venus receives the time assigned to her by the Moon, if it is a diurnal birth <note>A birth occurring during the day</note>, she decrees the screeching of sterility; if, however, it is a nocturnal birth, she grants the greatest increases in profit, especially if the Moon is diminished in splendor and light.

**Mercury** ☿ assigns **twenty months** from its own ten-year period to the **Moon** ☽, if she has been made the lord of the times. Therefore, when Mercury receives the time assigned to him by the Moon, he decrees cold sicknesses, particularly with the greatest weakness of the body.

By these reasonings, **Mauortius**, our honor, the sum of the times is divided. But I do not wish for abrupt judgments to be brought forward in defining these treatments. For frequently, if a benevolent star receives the time assigned to it, but then has a malevolent star of that period with it which looks upon it with a square or diameter radiation, it surrenders the decree of its goodness to the power of the malevolent star. You will find this same thing by a similar reasoning in the case of a malevolent star. For if a malevolent star receives the time assigned to it, and a benevolent star then mitigates it—either by being placed alongside it or by being arranged in a prosperous radiation—every decree of misfortune is relieved by the salvific protection of the benevolent star. Thus, the discipline of this completed work has been shared with you so that it may be understood; nor is there yet anything else that is required. For we have narrated in a teachable discourse everything with which we ought to instruct unrefined minds. Since we have now approached the very threshold of secrets through the first initiations of the ceremonies, we ought to listen to the rest with an intent mind, lest—with ears set in boredom and rejecting these words—we force in the perishing opinions of wandering treatises. Therefore, with Book Six completed, let all the zeal of speaking be transferred to the secrets of Book Seven, under favorable omens <note>original: "bonis auibus"; literally "with good birds," a reference to the Roman practice of augury where the flight of birds determined divine favor</note> and a happy star.

## YOUNGER, A SICILIAN AND MAN OF DISTINGUISHED RANK, TO MAUORTIUS LOL-
### lianus, Proconsul.

When Orpheus revealed the ceremonies of the sacred rites to unknown men, he required nothing else from those he was initiating in the first vestibule except the necessity of an oath, and he demanded this with a certain terrible authority of religion, lest the secrets of the discovered and composed religion be betrayed to profane ears. And Plato also frequently kept the *Timaeus* back for a long time, lest he should at some point share the venerable commentaries of secret disputations with the unskilled. For all these things suffer loss when they are thrust upon ruined and desperate minds. Among the Pythagoreans, our **Porphyry** <note>A Neoplatonist philosopher who wrote about the Life of Pythagoras</note> also consecrated our feasting minds with religious silence. Whence I also, following the law of these men, bind you by an oath, **Mauortius**, our honor, by the God who is the maker of the world, who fashioned all things by the necessity of eternity, who established the sun and the moon, who arranged the courses and orders of all the stars, who confined the waves of the sea within the fixed boundaries of the earth, who kindled fire for his own everlasting substance, who suspended the earth placed in the middle with balanced moderation, who [made] men...

## THE BIRTH CHARTS OF THE ABANDONED, OR THOSE NOT RAISED.
### Chapter I.

Therefore, for those whose Ascendant <term>horoscopus; the degree of the zodiac rising on the eastern horizon at the moment of birth</term> is not seen by any benefic stars, and the Moon ☾ is positioned on one of the angles <term>cardines; the four pivotal points of the chart: the Ascendant, Midheaven, Descendant, and Lower Midheaven</term>, and Saturn ♄ is in the seventh house from the Ascendant (that is, positioned in the setting sign), those born are immediately abandoned <note>original: "exponuntur"; referring to the Roman practice of infant exposure, where unwanted children were left in public places</note> by their mothers. But if the Ascendant is in those signs which have short rising times, and Saturn ♄ is in the seventh place from the Ascendant (that is, in the setting), while the Moon ☾, waning in light, is carried toward Saturn ♄, or if full toward Mars ♂, the newborn infant will similarly be abandoned. Furthermore, if the Lord of Fortune <note>the planetary ruler of the "Part of Fortune," a calculated mathematical point in the chart</note> (that is, the ruler of that sign in which the Lot of Fortune is found) and the ruler of the sign in which the Ascendant is located are hidden under the rays of the Sun ☉ <note>combust; too close to the sun to be seen</note>, or if they are placed in those signs which we mentioned before, and Saturn ♄ and Mars ♂ are in a nocturnal birth chart, the newborn infant will be abandoned. But if the Moon ☾ is found in the Ascendant or in the setting, and Saturn ♄ and Mars ♂ are joined in an opposite aspect <note>original: "diametra radiatione"; a 180-degree opposition</note>, or if one malefic star is found with the Moon ☾ at the time of conception, the one who is born will be abandoned. If, however, the Sun ☉ and Moon ☾ look upon each other in opposition, or if they are in square aspect <note>a 90-degree angle</note>, provided they form these patterns on the angles, and malefic stars are positioned together with both—that is, if the Sun ☉ is in the Ascendant and the Moon ☾ is in the setting, or the Moon ☾ in the Ascendant and the Sun ☉ in the setting, and Mars ♂ is with one and Saturn ♄ with the other—the infant, placed in great distress during the birth itself, is extinguished by suffocation. If, moreover, the malefic stars mentioned above, having become powerful, look upon the Moon ☾ with a threatening aspect, the mother also incurs a grave danger of death during the birth itself. If the Sun ☉ is found in the Ascendant and the Moon ☾ is full of light, in whatever sign she is carried toward Saturn ♄, while Saturn ♄ is positioned on one of the angles, the one born will perish after being abandoned. But if the Moon ☾ is found with Mars ♂ on any angle, and the Sun ☉ is positioned in the opposite sign with Saturn ♄, and the testimony of Jupiter ♃ is lacking for all of these, the one born will either be abandoned or will perish immediately along with the mother. If the Moon ☾ is found on any angle and Mars ♂ looks upon her from any other angle in opposition, or is found in the same part with her, and Saturn ♄ looks upon her from a superior position or is positioned in the sign following an angle <term>anaphora; the house that "rises after" or follows an angle</term>, the one born will be abandoned. But if the star of Jupiter ♃ is found on any angle and Venus ♀ looks upon it from a superior position, it will cause the abandoned to either be found or returned, especially if Venus ♀ looks upon Mars ♂ with any aspect. If the Sun ☉ with Saturn ♄ is found in the Ascendant and the Moon ☾ is positioned in the Midheaven (MC), while Mars ♂, placed in the Lower Midheaven (IMC), looks upon the Moon ☾ in opposition, the one born will be abandoned. But if, with the Sun ☉ in the Ascendant and the Moon ☾ in the Midheaven, Saturn ♄ is in the setting and Mars ♂ is in the Lower Midheaven, the one born will perish immediately after being abandoned, or the mother will die along with the child. However, what is always and generally appropriate to observe is this: if the Sun ☉ and Moon ☾ are positioned on any of the angles and Mars ♂ and Saturn ♄ look upon them in opposition, or one in opposition and the other in square, either those born will be abandoned <insert>*</insert> or they will perish immediately, or their mothers will perish with them in a miserable death. If Mars ♂ and Saturn ♄ are found on any angle, or one of them is on an angle and the other is in the sign following an angle or falling from an angle <term>epicataphora; a house falling away from an angle</term>, and the Moon ☾ is struck by one of them by either an opposition or a square aspect, or is positioned with them, the one thus born will be abandoned. If, however, while these are so positioned, a benefic star receives the conjunction of the approaching Moon ☾, those abandoned will be taken up by others and restored to freedom,

When the Sun and Moon possess the thirtieth degree of any sign, the one who is born will possess no span of life. If, moreover (as we have said), they are positioned in tropical signs without the testimony of benefic stars, the newborn will perish immediately in the water.

If, however, some benefic star regards the Moon ☽ so positioned with Mars ♂, the infant is brought forth cut into pieces limb by limb, but the mother is freed from the danger of death.

But if the Lot of Fortune is found in the seventh house from the Ascendant, and the lord of that sign is either in that sign itself or hidden under the Sun’s ☉ rays in the Midheaven, the newborn will not be reared. In whichever sign the Lot of Fortune is found, if the lord of that sign is positioned in either the post-ascension of the Ascendant or the sixth house from the Ascendant and does not see the Lot of Fortune, the newborn will not be reared. If, however, the Lot of Fortune is in the post-ascension of the Ascendant, and the lord of that sign is in the Midheaven, hidden under the Sun’s ☉ rays, the newborn will not be reared.

# BOOK SEVEN.

### BIRTH CHARTS OF TWINS, INCLUDING
### their sex. Chapter II.

If Jupiter ♃ and Mercury ☿ are positioned together in the Ascendant <term>horoscopus; the point of the zodiac rising on the eastern horizon</term>, and the Ascendant itself is in a double-bodied sign <note>The "double" signs are Gemini, Sagittarius, Pisces, and sometimes Virgo, often associated with duality or twins</note>, and if the Moon ☽ is found in any of the angles <term>cardine; the four pivotal points of a chart: 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses</term>, while the Sun ☉ has another planet joined to it in its sign, the birth chart will produce either twins, or the person born will have twin children. One must observe, however, that no malefic star <note>Saturn or Mars</note>, being in a superior position, looks upon them. For if a malefic star looks upon one of them, whichever was conceived first will either die during birth or perish before being born <note>original: "antè conceptus efficietur"</note>. But if the Moon ☽ is not found in the angles, nor in a double-bodied sign, but Jupiter ♃ and Mercury ☿ are found together in the Ascendant in a double-bodied sign as we said before, and the Moon ☽ or Sun ☉ is placed with another planet, twins will be born. If the Moon ☽ is found with either Jupiter ♃ or Mercury ☿, and the Sun ☉ has another planet joined to it, and being positioned in double-bodied signs they look upon each other with any aspect <note>radiatione; the "rays" or astrological aspects between planets</note>, and if the Ascendant is found in a double-bodied sign and has any planet joined to it, twins will be born. 

But if the Moon ☽ is found in the signs of Sagittarius ♐ or Gemini ♊, and Jupiter ♃ and Mercury ☿ are positioned in the Ascendant or in the setting <term>occasu; the 7th house or Descendant</term>, twins will be born. If the Moon ☽ is found in a double-bodied sign and the Sun ☉ is positioned in an angle, occupying the second sign from the Moon, or certainly if the Sun is in a double-bodied sign placed with Jupiter ♃ or Mercury ☿, they will either be born as twins or have twin children. 

But whether they will be born male or female, we shall gather by calculation. For if the Sun ☉, the Moon ☽, and the Ascendant are positioned in masculine signs, and the testimonies of masculine stars are added—that is, Jupiter ♃, Mars ♂, or the Sun ☉—males will be born. But if Venus ♀ alone does this, positioned in a feminine sign, while the Sun ☉, Moon ☽, and Ascendant are joined in the manner we described, twins of different sexes are procreated. If Mars ♂ and Saturn ♄ are positioned in their own houses and look upon the Sun ☉, the Moon ☽, and the Ascendant, and no ray of a benefic star reaches them, the twins will either be miscarried or, being born prematurely, will perish immediately. 

If, however, with all these things positioned as we said, the rays of both benefic and malefic stars reach them by this calculation, whichever of the twins comes out first will die. If the Moon ☽ is found in any angle, specifically in the second sign, and a benefic star is positioned together with it, and the Ascendant is in a double-bodied sign—either with the second house, or with Jupiter ♃, or with Mercury ☿, or in the third or fifth house—twins will be born. If the ruler of the sign in which the specific place of children <note>locus filiorum; a mathematical point or "Lot" in the chart relating to offspring</note> is found is in a double-bodied sign, and the fifth house from the Ascendant is positioned in a double-bodied sign, and the Moon ☽ is similarly placed in a double-bodied sign, and Jupiter ♃ or Mercury ☿ looks upon it by any aspect or is found together with it, twins will be born.

### ->BIRTHS OF FREEDMEN AND FREEMEN. CHAPTER V.<-

When Jupiter ♃ or Saturn ♄ are positioned together in the Bottom of the Sky <term>I M C; the Imum Coeli or 4th House, representing home and roots</term>, and the Sun ☉ is in the second house from the Ascendant, say that the father was a slave. If, however, the Sun ☉ is found in the house of Saturn ♄ <note>original: "domo ♄" – Capricorn or Aquarius</note>, and Saturn ♄ is in the sixth house from the Ascendant, it shows the father was a slave. If the Moon ☽ is found with Mars ♂ in equal degrees in foreign signs <note>alienis signis; signs where the planet has no traditional dignity</note> in the Ascendant, it will without doubt make the mother a handmaid. But if the lord of that sign in which the Moon ☽ is found is either in its place of low dignity or in cast-down houses, it demonstrates by a similar reasoning that the mother was a handmaid. If indeed the Moon ☽, diminished in light, is found with Mars ♂ in the Ascendant, and Saturn ♄ is in the house rising after the Ascendant (anaphora), it will make the mother a handmaid. But if the Moon ☽ is positioned in the Bottom of the Sky (IMC), and the lord of that place is found in the sixth house from the Ascendant, it demonstrates the mother was a handmaid. If indeed you see the Sun ☉ and Jupiter ♃ in cast-down places <note>deiectis locis; houses considered weak or unlucky, like the 6th, 8th, or 12th</note>, either together or divided, and one is in the twelfth house from the Ascendant, the other in the sixth, say that the father was a slave. If the Moon ☽ and Venus ♀ are found in the setting point—that is, in the seventh house from the Ascendant—specifically in a tropical sign <term>tropico signo; a cardinal sign such as Aries, Cancer, Libra, or Capricorn</term>, and one malefic star is positioned in the sixth house from the Ascendant, and another in the eighth, and Jupiter ♃ is neither in the primary angles nor regards them with a trine aspect <note>trigonica radiatione; a favorable 120-degree angle</note>, it demonstrates the mothers were handmaids, and those to whom the custody of the doors <note>original: "ianuariū custodia" – likely meaning doorkeepers or janitors</note> is entrusted. If the Sun ☉ and the Moon ☽ are found in the sixth house from the Ascendant, and the lord of the sign is positioned together in that same place, these weigh down the parents with the burden of both slavery and unhappiness. If, however, benefic stars are found in the angles, some happiness will later be conferred upon the parents. If the Sun ☉ and Moon ☽ are found in places cast down from the Ascendant, and Saturn ♄ regards Venus ♀ positioned in any angle with a diametrical aspect <note>diametra radiatione; an opposition or 180-degree angle</note>, or a square aspect, or is found with her, they will make them slaves. But if Mars ♂ is with Venus ♀, just as we have said, it accomplishes this same thing by similar reasoning. If indeed the Sun ☉ and Moon ☽ are positioned in cast-down places, and malefic stars are placed either in the same sign, or in that where the Lot of Fortune <term>locus fortunę; a mathematical point representing prosperity</term> is established, or in the Ascendant, or in the other angles, or in the houses rising after the angles (anaphoras), they will similarly make them slaves. But if Saturn ♄ is found in the eighth house from the Ascendant, or in the house rising after the Ascendant (anaphora), and the Moon ☽ is either in the anaphoras or in the falling houses <term>epicataphoris; the 3rd, 6th, 9th, or 12th houses which "fall away" from the angles</term>, and Venus ♀ is hidden under the rays of the Sun ☉ <note>sub radijs; "combust," or so close to the Sun as to be invisible</note>, or is in the twelfth house from the Ascendant, it will make slaves and captives. If the Sun ☉ and Moon ☽ are positioned in cast-down places, and one of the malefic stars is placed exactly in an angle, it will make them slaves. But if, when these are arranged as we have said, benefic stars receive the conjunction of the waxing Moon ☽, or if they are found exactly in an angle or in the falling houses (epicataphoris), the born slaves will obtain the rewards of freedom, or be nourished in the place of sons. If the Sun ☉ and Moon ☽ are not in cast-down places, but Saturn ♄ or Mars ♂ is positioned exactly in some angle, while the other of them is placed in the houses rising after (anaphoras), and both the Sun ☉ and Moon ☽ regard them with any aspect, they will make them captives. But if a benefic star, either placed in the angles or in the house rising after the angles, regards all these so arranged with a favorable aspect, it will free them from captivity through prosperous protection. But if several benefic stars, positioned in the higher places, receive the conjunction of the waxing Moon ☽, with the others being arranged as we have said, they will free those coming into the very dangers of captivity.

If the Sun ☉ and Moon ☽ are found in feminine signs, either placed together or in different locations, and Venus ♀ is positioned in a feminine sign in any angle, while Mercury ☿ and Mars ♂ are positioned precisely in any angle, they will produce either eunuchs or hermaphrodites. ### Birth charts of SONS DISAGREEING WITH THEIR FATHERS. Chapter IX.

If in a birth chart the Sun ☉ or Saturn ♄ is found in the fourth house from the Ascendant <term>horoscopus; the point rising on the eastern horizon</term>, while the Moon ☽ is in the eighth, either the son will be alienated from the father, or they will have quarrels due to deep-seated grudges. But if Mars ♂ is found in the house rising after the Ascendant, or in the house rising after the Midheaven <term>M C; the Medium Coeli or 10th house</term>, this same result is achieved by similar logic. Furthermore, if the Sun ☉ is found exactly in the Ascendant or in the Midheaven, while the Moon ☽ is positioned in the West <note>The 7th house or Descendant</note> or in the Bottom of the Sky <term>I M C; the Imum Coeli or 4th house</term>, this same effect will also occur. If indeed these malefic placements we mentioned occur with the Moon ☽, quarrels and enmities are stirred up between the mother and the children, especially if Saturn ♄ regards the Moon ☽ in this way. 

But whoever has the Sun ☉ in the bounds <term>finibus; specific degree-segments of a sign ruled by a planet</term> of Mars ♂ in a daytime birth, or in a nighttime birth has Saturn ♄ and the Sun ☉—and if Mars ♂ by day, or Saturn ♄ by night, regards them with a square or diameter aspect, and the ray of a benefic star does not mitigate this—the sons will kill their fathers. If the Moon ☽ is found in such a condition, they will kill their mothers. 

If the Sun ☉ is established in the bounds or houses of malefic stars and is placed in the sixth or twelfth house from the Ascendant, and while so positioned, a malefic star regards it with a square or diameter aspect, they will cause sons to be disinherited by their fathers. If, however, a benefic star regards the Sun ☉ so positioned from any side, the severity of the father's animosity is mitigated. If the Sun ☉ is found in the house rising after the Ascendant <note>the 2nd house</note> or in the eighth house from the Ascendant, the son will not indeed be disinherited by the father, but the paternal inheritance will be wasted away in some manner. If benefic stars regard the Sun ☉ positioned as we said, only a small portion of the father’s resources will be lost. The Moon ☽ will bring about this same effect regarding mothers or maternal inheritances. 

Furthermore, if the Moon ☽ is positioned in a birth chart holding either the 15th or 17th degree in a tropical sign <note>The "turning" signs: Aries, Cancer, Libra, or Capricorn</note>, and malefic stars regard her with a square or diameter aspect, the maternal inheritance is squandered. If, however, benefic stars regard the Moon ☽ so positioned with any aspect, something of the maternal resources is preserved. But if the Sun ☉ and Mars ♂ are together in any angle in a tropical sign, they cause the paternal resources to be squandered. If a benefic star regards them so positioned, something of the father's resources is preserved; and the Moon ☽, positioned thus, will perform the same in a maternal birth chart.

### The TIME AND CONDITION OF THE PARENTS' DEATH. Chapter X.

In anyone’s birth chart, if the Sun ☉ is poorly placed, or the lord of the sign in which the Sun ☉ is found is poorly placed, the father will perish first. If the Moon ☽ suffers this, it will be the mother. What we are saying is of this nature: if the Ascendant is in Taurus ♉, the Sun ☉ is found in Aquarius ♒, and Saturn ♄ is in Pisces ♓ or in the signs square to Pisces ♓, the lord of the Sun's sign—which is Saturn ♄—is afflicted. Because of this, the father of this birth will perish first, because the Sun ☉ has fallen into the place of an afflicted and malefic killer. If this should happen to the Moon ☽, we say the mother perishes first. 

If, with these factors arranged as we said, Mars ♂ also regards Saturn ♄ with a square aspect, the father will die a violent death <term>biothanatus; someone who dies by execution, suicide, or violence</term>, by the order or wrath of a ruler. If, however, with these factors so arranged, Jupiter ♃ is found in the angles, the father's misfortunes are mitigated—especially if he regards the Sun ☉ in a daytime birth, or the Moon ☽ in a nighttime birth. For what we said regarding the Moon ☽ suffering this in a nighttime birth means the mother will likewise perish. But then these evils grow more powerful if, with things arranged as we said, the benefic stars are either in downcast places or hidden under the rays of the Sun ☉. If the Sun ☉ is established in any angle and a planet regards it with a diameter or square aspect, or is in the same sign composed in an equal partnership of degrees, the father, as a violent death, by order of a ruler...

If indeed "temporal" Saturn ♄ does this to the Moon ☽, the mother will die: but this is not always the case. That which is gathered from the preceding calculation <note>referring to the calculation of the "Lot" or "Arabic Part" described in the paragraph above</note>, however, shows the death by true reasoning.

### THE BIRTHS AND CHARTS OF ORPHANED CHILDREN. Chapter XI.

If indeed the Sun ☉ alone is placed as we said, only the father will perish; if the Moon ☽, the mother. But these cases are found up to the fifteenth and sixteenth year. For within this time, stars ordered as we said announce to us the deaths of parents. 

You will find the time of the deaths when "temporal" Saturn ♄ reaches these places which we marked in the preceding demonstration. But if the angles are in double signs, and the Sun ☉ and Moon ☽ are in the descendant or in the Midheaven, and the ruler of the birth chart is also in the descendant or the Midheaven, the parents die in the children's first age <note>infancy or early childhood</note>. ### Birth charts of ADOPTED CHILDREN.
### Chapter XII.

**V**enus, if she is found in Gemini ♊, or in the trines <note>signs 120 degrees apart belonging to the same element</note> of the Gemini signs, or in Gemini ♊ or Taurus ♉, will cause one to be adopted; but in Gemini ♊ and Taurus ♉, she will do this even if she is not on the angles <term>cardinibus; the four most powerful points of a chart: the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses</term>. In the others, however, which we have mentioned, she will cause the persons born to be adopted only when she is found on an angle.

### The number of SIBLINGS for any person born.
### Chapter XIII.

**C**ount from Saturn ♄ to Jupiter ♃, and an equal distance from the Ascendant <term>horoscopus; the degree of the zodiac rising on the eastern horizon</term>, and into whatever sign the final number falls, that sign itself shows you the number of the brotherhood. If, however, malefic stars <note>Mars or Saturn</note> look upon this place, the siblings will perish, or they will become mortal enemies; if benefics <note>Jupiter or Venus</note>, they will be increased. But if Saturn ♄ is found on the exact degree in the Ascendant, and those degrees belong to Saturn ♄, all siblings will perish within the years of youth. Others count from Mercury ☿ to the Sun ☉, and an equal distance from the Ascendant, and thus they define the place of siblings. Saying other things about that place by a similar reasoning, this treatise also has efficacy in the outcomes <note>original: "apotelesmatis"; the results or predictions of an astrological configuration</note>.

### The birth records or charts of INCESTUOUS PERSONS.
### Chapter XIIII.

**I**n a man’s birth chart, count from Saturn ♄ to Venus ♀ if it is a daytime birth, and an equal distance from the Ascendant; but in a nocturnal birth, do the opposite. And this sign (as we have frequently said) shows you the place of the wife. Again, calculate the place of siblings from Saturn ♄ to Jupiter ♃, and an equal distance from the Ascendant. Therefore, if the place of the spouse, así constituted by degree, falls into the place of the siblings as calculated (as we have said), these men will obtain their sisters or their female relatives as wives. You will find the same in the birth charts of women. But if Venus ♀ is found together with the Lord of the Birth <note>the planet that rules the chart</note> in the same sign, it decrees sisters or female relatives as wives. But if the place of the spouse, calculated by degree, is found in maternal or paternal signs—and these collected by a specific degree calculation—it decrees mothers, or stepmothers, or nurses as wives. You will find the same in the birth charts of women, especially if Mars ♂, Venus ♀, or Mercury ☿ look upon these same places. 

And because we have begun to speak of incestuous marriages, setting aside other things, let them reconsider these points. If in a birth chart Saturn ♄ is found in the sign or the bounds <term>finibus; specific subdivisions of a zodiac sign ruled by different planets</term> of Aquarius ♒, while Jupiter ♃ and Venus ♀ are in the sign of Saturn ♄, and Mars ♂ and the Moon ☽ look upon them so placed with a square aspect <note>90 degrees</note>, these persons will have intercourse with either their mothers or their stepmothers. If indeed Mercury ☿ is joined to them, they will have intercourse with their sons, or daughters, or stepchildren. But if the Moon ☽ is found with the Sun ☉, Saturn ♄, and Mars ♂ in the house of Venus ♀, they will have intercourse in secret with either the mother, or the stepmother, or the father. If indeed all these are found (as we have said) in the seventh house from the Ascendant, this man will obtain his mother as a wife after the death of the father; or after the death of the mother, the daughter will do this same thing with the father. If indeed Mercury ☿ is found with them, women obtain their own sons as husbands, and men their own daughters as wives. But if the Moon ☽, positioned in the final degrees of Gemini ♊, is carried toward Jupiter ♃, or is in the house of Saturn ♄, while Venus ♀ is found similarly in the house of Saturn ♄, and Jupiter ♃ in the house of Venus ♀, this same thing is accomplished by a similar logic. 

If Venus ♀ is found with Mars ♂ in the sixth house from the Ascendant, it will make both men and women adulterers. If indeed they are positioned in the house of Saturn ♄, and joined with Saturn ♄ himself in the same sign in a partnership of degrees, and they are in the seventh house from the Ascendant, in the birth charts of women they make public prostitutes, but in the births of men this is decreed: that they either have prostitutes as wives, or they are joined in an impure desire of lust with public catamites <note>original: "cínædís"; men who took a passive role in same-sex acts, often associated with performance or public scandal</note>, and they are Socratic pederasts <note>original: "Socratici pædícones"; a derogatory reference to those who practice "Greek love," using Socrates as a historical archetype for male-male attraction</note>.

## The birth charts of EFFEMINATE MEN, the IMPURE, and the STERILE. 
## Chapter XVI.

**M**ercury ☿ and Venus ♀, if they are positioned together in the 19th degree of Taurus ♉, will make persons who are impure of mouth <note>original: "impuros ore"; a Roman reference to oral sex, which was socially taboo</note>. If in a nocturnal birth the Moon ☽ is found in the 12th or 6th house from the Ascendant, or in a diurnal birth the Sun ☉ is positioned in those same places—and if the Moon ☽ in a nocturnal birth is in the boundaries of Venus ♀, or the Sun ☉ in a diurnal birth is in those same boundaries—and if Venus ♀ is located in the 7th house from the Ascendant or in the IC <term>IMC; Imum Coeli, the lowest point of the chart or 4th house</term> and in her own boundaries, *cinaedi* will be born. I will now explain to you the specific "Place of Lusts" by degree, so that you can find these vices with true reasoning. # JULIUS FIRMICUS MATERNUS

If Venus ♀ has been placed in the primary angles <term>cardinibus; the four most powerful points of a chart: the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses</term>, it will make wealthy *cinaedi* <note>original: "cinaedos"; effeminate men or those who take the passive role in intercourse</note>. If Venus ♀ and Mercury ☿ are positioned in tropical signs <term>cardinal signs; Aries, Cancer, Libra, or Capricorn</term> and regard each other by a square <note>90 degrees</note> or diameter <note>180 degrees</note> radiation, especially when placed in feminine signs, they will produce *cinaedi*, but those who are secretly involved in these vices. If, however, they are positioned in a "station" <note>appearing to stand still in the sky</note> and occupy the signs we mentioned without the testimony of Jupiter ♃, they will make the women into harlots and prostitutes, and the men into public *cinaedi* who prostitute themselves without any shame.

### The Number of Wives or Husbands.
### Chapter XVII.

In all birth charts, if Venus ♀ is found in "double" signs <term>mutable signs; Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, or Pisces</term> or in tropical signs, and the rulers of the signs in which she is placed are likewise positioned in double or tropical signs, they decree many wives for men and many husbands for women. But if Venus ♀ is found in neither tropical nor double signs, and the Moon ☽ regards her in the same way, one wife is decreed for the man and one husband for the woman. However, if Venus ♀ is placed in tropical or double signs and sees the Moon ☽, she decrees many wives for men and many husbands for women. 

In all birth charts likewise, if Saturn ♄ is found with Venus ♀ in the same sign, and Jupiter ♃ has more "parts" <note>higher degrees or more influence</note>, he decrees one wife; if Venus ♀ has more, she decrees many. You will find the same in the charts of women. If Venus ♀ is positioned in the setting <term>occasu; the 7th house, the area of the sky where stars set</term>, she will give a wife who has been corrupted by others, or they will cohabit without formal marriage contracts. If Mars ♂ sees her, he will grant wives known for adultery. 

If Venus ♀ is thus arranged and is in Taurus ♉ or Libra ♎, she will give noble-born wives; but if she is positioned in the other signs, Saturn ♄ [will influence the outcome]. If Venus ♀ is found in Scorpio ♏ or with the Moon ☽, and the Moon ☽ regards her with a trine radiation <note>120 degrees apart</note>, and she also has the testimony of the other stars, she decrees one wife. If she is found in any other sign, calculate from Venus ♀ herself up to that sign in which the "place of the spouse" <note>a specific calculated point in the zodiac</note> is found degree-by-degree <note>original: "partiliter"</note>: however many signs there are from Venus ♀ to the sign of marriage, that many wives are decreed. You will find the same for husbands in feminine charts. Some approve of this method; but by us, to be honest, it is hardly approved at all.

### The Mutual Affection of Spouses.
### Chapter XVIII.

If the place of the wife is found degree-by-degree—specifically by that method we showed in the preceding book—and if it is found in the sign of Pisces ♓, let the man be separated from all the allurements of lusts. If Jupiter ♃ himself sees this same place positioned in the sign of Gemini ♊, or is found in that very place, he grows stronger for the sake of modesty. 

However, if it is in the house of Saturn ♄ <note>Capricorn or Aquarius</note>, it will make them lustful; but if Saturn ♄ sees this place, he makes the men stern toward women. But if it is found in the sign of Aries ♈, and Mars ♂ or Saturn ♄ regard this same place, or one of them is in the place itself while the other regards it, he will make the men always love their wives with a faithful affection. 

If this place is found in the sign of Cancer ♋ and Mercury ☿ sees the place or is positioned there, he will make fickle lovers; the Sun ☉ makes them royal; the Moon ☽ makes them pleasing and lovable. If the Moon ☽ is found with Mars ♂ in the house of Saturn ♄, and Saturn ♄ regards them with a diameter or square radiation, he will make people without a wife, without children, and consumptive <note>original: "phthisicos"; suffering from a wasting disease like tuberculosis</note>. If Jupiter ♃ with Venus ♀ is found in the setting, men will willingly consort with males, and women with old men. If they are found thus in the Ascendant <term>horoscopo; the point of the zodiac rising in the east</term>, men will more willingly consort with younger partners, and women with youths.

### The Times of Betrothals or Marriages.
### Chapter XIX.

When you have found the place of the spouse degree-by-degree, if the ruler of that sign is found in the same sign, marriage is decreed once the "first years" of that sign are completed. But if the ruler of the sign is so placed that it does not regard the sign of the place of the spouse by any radiation, but another star is positioned in that sign, marriage is decreed once the "first times" of that star are completed. If no star is placed in that sign, a wife is decreed after the "ascension" <note>original: "anaphoram"</note> of that sign. 

But there is another more subtle method composed of degree-by-degree calculation. Calculate the "substance" <note>likely the total sum of degrees</note> of all the stars and make one sum from the total number. Divide this sum among the signs, starting from that sign in which the place of the spouse was found degree-by-degree, giving thirty parts <note>degrees</note> to each sign. In whichever sign the final number falls, when Jupiter ♃ reaches that sign, then marriage is decreed. Because this is somewhat obscure, I will explain this same thing to you again more clearly through an example...

## The birth charts of KILLERS OF THEIR OWN WIVES. Chapter XX.

If Venus ♀ is found in the house of Mars ♂ and in his bounds <term>fines; specific segments of a zodiac sign ruled by a planet</term>, and Mars ♂ is positioned in the house of Venus ♀ or her bounds, and he regards the Moon ☽—when she is placed in her own signs or bounds and is full of light—by a diameter radiation <note>an opposition of 180 degrees</note>, the husbands will kill their own wives with their own hands. If, however, in a woman’s birth chart, Mars ♂ is positioned in his own house or parts and is found in the Midheaven <term>M C; the highest point of the chart, representing career and public life</term>, and he regards Venus ♀ by a diameter radiation, the husbands will be killed and perish at the hands of their wives. But all these things are mitigated and turned toward a better outcome by the testimony <note>the supportive influence or "aspect"</note> of Jupiter ♃.

## THE BIRTH CHARTS OF THOSE LACKING LITERACY. Chapter XXI.

If Mercury ☿ and Jupiter ♃ are positioned together, so that being placed in one sign they are joined in an equal fellowship of degrees, and Mars ♂ does not regard them with any radiation, or certainly if Mars is not established in the Ascendant <term>horoscopo; the rising sign on the eastern horizon</term>, they will make people lacking in letters and most unrefined.

## The birth charts of GLADIATORS OR ATHLETES. Chapter XXII.

If Jupiter ♃ is positioned in the bounds of Mars ♂, in whatever sign he may be, and Mars ♂ is in the bounds of Jupiter ♃, and if, being positioned in the angles <term>cardinibus; the four most powerful points of a chart</term>, they regard each other with a square <note>90 degrees</note> or diameter radiation, and it is a daytime birth, and the Sun ☉ is in places "dejected" <note>cadent houses, which are weakened positions</note> from the Ascendant—or likewise for the Moon ☽ in a nighttime birth—famous gladiators will be born. If Mars ♂ is found in the bounds of Venus ♀, in whatever sign he may be, and Venus ♀ is likewise in the bounds of Mars ♂, and Jupiter ♃ regards both of them with any radiation, athletes will be born. If indeed they are positioned in the angles, they will be born as athletes who are victors in every clash of competitions. But if the testimony of Mercury ☿ and Mars ♂ is present, wrestlers <note>original: "palæstritæ"</note> or masters of athletes will be born, but those who never commit themselves to the actual contests. If Mars ♂ is established in the bounds of Mercury ☿, and Mercury ☿ in turn in the bounds of Mars ♂, and the testimony of Jupiter ♃ and Venus ♀ is added through any fellowship of radiation, or if Venus ♀ alone provides testimony, it will produce runners. But these effects grow stronger if the Lot of Fortune <note>a calculated mathematical point in the chart</note> and the Place of Activity are found in an angle and are joined to the fellowship of the preceding stars.

## The birth charts of LAWYERS OR ORATORS. Chapter XXIII.

If Mercury ☿ is found in his own bounds or in the bounds of Mars ♂, and is established in "dejected" places, and Jupiter ♃, positioned in the house of Mercury ☿ or his bounds, regards him with any radiation, it will produce lawyers <note>original: "causidicos"</note> and orators. If indeed the Sun ☉ is positioned as we said in a daytime birth, and is not in dejected places, and Mars ♂, positioned in the angles and in those parts we mentioned, regards him with a favorable radiation, it will produce great and famous orators.

## THE BIRTH CHARTS OF "PODALIRIAN" DOCTORS. Chapter XXIIII.

But if Mercury ☿ is not joined to them, they will be cooks.

# BOOK SEVEN. 209
# VARIOUS MODES OF VIOLENT DEATH, AND
## the uncertain end. Chapter XXVII.

If the **Sun ☉** is found in watery signs, and **Mars ♂** is positioned in the same sign or place with the **Moon ☽** by degree, or if it is placed together with **Mars ♂** in the eleventh or sixth house from the **Horoscope** <note>the Ascendant or rising sign</note>, with **Saturn ♄** aspecting the **Horoscope** by opposition, those born will be <term>biothanati; individuals destined for a violent or unnatural death</term>. For they will either perish by hanging from a noose or meet their final end by drowning in water. If the **Moon ☽** is joined with **Saturn ♄** in an exact degree and found in the eighth house from the **Horoscope**, and no benefic star <note>a "good" planet like Jupiter or Venus</note> is positioned on a cardinal point, death will be brought about by excessive loss of blood. If, however, with these things so arranged, a benefic star is found on another cardinal point, they will recover from hopeless conditions through medical remedies.

If, indeed, the **Moon ☽** is found with **Mars ♂** in the seventh house from the **Horoscope**, it will cause them to perish from hemorrhages. Generally, however, **Saturn ♄** in a nocturnal birth, or **Mars ♂** in a diurnal birth, when positioned in the seventh house from the **Horoscope**, produces eruptions of blood. But if the **Place of Fortune** <note>original: "locus fortunae"; a calculated point in the chart representing fate and material well-being</note> is found in their signs in the seventh house from the **Horoscope**, they will suffer ailments and be cut by iron <note>the "iron" usually refers to surgical tools or weapons</note>. If, with these things arranged as we said, a benefic star provides a favorable testimony by its aspect, they will be liberated from that sickness after being cut by iron.

But if both, that is **Saturn ♄** and **Mars ♂**, are positioned in the seventh house from the **Horoscope**, and the **Horoscope** or the **Place of Fortune** is also located in those signs we mentioned—that is, if the **Sun ☉** or **Saturn ♄**, or one of them, is placed in the seventh house from the **Horoscope** while another aspects it by a square or opposite radiation—they will perish while being cut by doctors.

If the **Moon ☽** is found in the setting house <note>the 7th house, where the sun sets</note>, and **Mars ♂** and **Saturn ♄** are joined with it in an exact degree in the **Midheaven** <note>original: "Medium Coeli"; the 10th house, representing public life and status</note>, they will produce murderers and parricides, or those who are stained with a brother's blood by a wicked instinct of madness; but having been struck by the infamy of such crimes and exposed by public hatred and threatening accusation, the planets will cause them to perish by the severe punishments of judges.

If the **Moon ☽** and **Mars ♂** are positioned in the ninth house from the **Horoscope**, and the **Sun ☉** and **Mercury ☿** in the third, they produce sacrilegious men and plunderers of temples; but those who, because of this crime, will be punished by the judge's severe sentence. If indeed the **Sun ☉** is positioned with **Saturn ♄**, **Mars ♂**, and **Mercury ☿** in the eleventh house from the **Horoscope**, and the **Moon ☽** is placed in the third house from the **Horoscope** without the testimony of **Jupiter ♃**, they will cause the **biothanati** to perish because of the aforementioned crimes.

If the **Sun ☉** is found in the **Horoscope**, while **Mars ♂** and **Saturn ♄**, joined in equal degrees, are placed in the twelfth house from the **Horoscope**, and they aspect the **Moon ☽** (placed in the sixth house from the **Horoscope**) by an opposite radiation, they will make them **biothanati** as slaves. If the **Horoscope** is found in a sign of **Saturn ♄** or **Mars ♂**, and the **Place of Fortune** is positioned by degree in the **Horoscope**, and with it **Mercury ☿** is joined in equal degrees, while **Saturn ♄** and **Mars ♂** are placed in the seventh house from the **Horoscope**, they will make them <term>epileptics; those suffering from seizures</term>, but also destined for a violent death.

If the **Moon ☽** is positioned by degree in the **Midheaven**, and **Mars ♂** is positioned by degree in the **Horoscope**, and if an <term>anaphora; the sign or house following another</term> is found in the **Moon ☽**, it will cause a violent death. But if the **Moon ☽** is found with **Mars ♂** in the eighth house from the **Horoscope**, and the **Sun ☉** with **Saturn ♄** is located in either the fifth or the twelfth house from the **Horoscope**, they will cause a violent death.

If indeed **Mars ♂** and **Saturn ♄** aspect by a square radiation—wherever **Mars ♂** may be positioned—and one of them sees the **Moon ☽** by either a square or opposite radiation, or is found with it, it will cause a violent death. But if the **Moon ☽** is found with **Mars ♂** in the eighth house from the **Horoscope**, and the **Sun ☉** is in the seventh, while **Saturn ♄** is positioned in the **Midheaven** or in any other cardinal point, it will cause a violent death.

If **Mars ♂** and **Saturn ♄** are found in the eleventh house from the **Horoscope**, or one of them is placed in that house while the other is positioned with the **Moon ☽**, or aspects it by a square radiation, and **Jupiter ♃** or **Mercury ☿** is joined by any radiation, it will produce those who are insane, epileptic, and destined for a violent death. But this will be worse if **Mars ♂** is found in the eleventh house from the **Horoscope** and **Saturn ♄** in the fifth.

If either the **Sun ☉** is found in the eighth house from the **Horoscope**, and the **Moon ☽** is positioned by degree in the **Midheaven**, and the **Horoscope** or the **Place of Fortune** is in the sign of the **Sun ☉** or in the sign of the **Moon ☽**, it will produce those who are insane and destined for a violent death.

If the **Place of Cupid** <note>original: "Cupidinis locus"; a specialized lot in Hellenistic astrology related to desire and social connection</note> and **Mars ♂** and **Saturn ♄** are joined by degree, and that place is positioned on any cardinal point of the birth chart, and **Venus ♀** aspects those we mentioned by any radiation, they will cause deaths by hemorrhage. But if they see **Venus ♀**, they will make them <term>lunatics; those whose mental health shifts with the moon</term>. If **Venus ♀** is found in <unclear>falsehood</unclear>, or with counterfeit money, they cause a violent death. But if **Jupiter ♃** aspects all these so positioned, they are liberated from all these dangers. If the **Moon ☾**, or the **Sun ☉**, should be in the **Horoscope** <note>the Ascendant or 1st house</note>, and **Mars ♂** and **Saturn ♄** are in their <term>anaphora; the house that "rises after" a cardinal point, such as the 2nd house following the 1st</term>, they will similarly cause the individuals to be afflicted in their eyes and to die as <term>biothanati; people who meet a violent or unnatural death</term>. 

But if the **Moon ☾** is found with **Mars ♂**, and **Saturn ♄** is positioned with the **Sun ☉** in the **Midheaven** <note>original: "M C," Medium Coeli; the 10th house</note>, it will cause spasms, or insanities, or a death by violent means. 

If, however, the **Moon ☾** and **Sun ☉** are found in the <term>cardinal points; the four main angles of the chart: 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses</term>, and **Mars ♂** and **Saturn ♄** are in their own houses, or are positioned in other cardinal points, they cause the individuals to die as biothanati. 

If **Mars ♂** or **Saturn ♄** are found in the **Place of Fortune**, and a <term>synodus; a meeting or conjunction of planets</term> occurs in the fifth or eleventh house from the **Horoscope**, they will bring about a biothanata death. 

If **Mars ♂** with the **Moon ☾** are in the twelfth house from the **Horoscope**, and **Saturn ♄** and the **Sun ☉** are in its anaphora—that is, positioned in the second house from the **Horoscope**—they cause them to die by a biothanata death; and frequently they are cut at the very moment of birth, brought forth piece by piece from the mother’s womb, especially if they are found in the same degrees. 

If the **Moon ☾** is found in the **Midheaven**, and some malefic star is positioned in any cardinal point, and another [planet] regards the **Moon ☾** with an aspect of opposition <note>original: "diametra radiatione"</note>, or if it similarly approaches the **Horoscope**, or if it is found in the fifth or eleventh house from the **Horoscope**, it will produce biothanati. For those so born either are thrown from a height, or they take their own lives; yet the diversity of the deaths is fulfilled by the nature of the zodiac sign. 

If the **Moon ☾** is found in the eighth house from the **Horoscope**, and **Mars ♂**, placed in his own house, is positioned exactly by degree in the **Horoscope**, and **Venus ♀** or the **Sun ☉** are joined to him in equal or neighboring degrees, and the **Moon ☾** receives a conjunction by degree with either **Mars ♂** or **Saturn ♄**, they will perish torn apart by the habits of wild beasts. 

If the **Moon ☾**, diminished in its light <note>original: "minuta luminibus"; a waning or dark moon</note>, is found in the eighth house from the **Horoscope**, it will create biothanati: but such that, being submerged naked, they meet a miserable end of death. 

If the **Moon ☾** is found in the setting <note>the 7th house</note>, and **Saturn ♄** in the sixth house from the **Horoscope**, and the **Place of Fortune** is located in the house of **Mars ♂** or the **Moon ☾**, it will cause them to die from dysentery. 

If the **Moon ☾** is found in the **Horoscope**, and **Saturn ♄** with **Jupiter ♃** is positioned in the seventh from the **Horoscope**, they will produce those who are foolish, sluggish, idiotic, and <term>epileptic; original: "caducos," meaning those who fall</term>. If, however, with these things so arranged, **Mars ♂** is found in any cardinal point, it will render them idiotic and epileptic, but also biothanati. 

If **Saturn ♄** is found in the third or the ninth house from the **Horoscope**, and **Mars ♂** regards him with a square aspect <note>an aspect of 90 degrees</note>, he will make them leaders of great affairs or acts; but whatever marriage is gathered by them will be dissipated. They will also have the greatest illnesses, and being situated in foreign places, they will be bound by many evils. It also debilitates their parents, or certainly causes them to die as biothanati. 

If, however, **Mercury ☿** is found with one of them, and **Mars ♂** is either with them or regards them with a square or opposite aspect, he will make them sacrilegious, plunderers of temples, leaders of bandits, murderers, and those who perish by a bad death. 

If the **Sun ☉**, **Saturn ♄**, and **Mercury ☿** are found in the **Midheaven**, they will cause accusations and dangers to be brought from hidden or false letters, or from forged money. If, however, **Mars ♂** regards them with a square or opposite aspect, or is found with them, he will make them bandits and murderers, yet also exiles and fugitives. 

If, with these things so arranged, **Jupiter ♃** is found in another cardinal point, after some time, being liberated from these calamities, they will be transferred to the grace of great power. If, however, with all these things so placed, the **Moon ☾** is found either in some cardinal point, or in the anaphoras or <term>epicataphoris; the "declining" or cadent houses, such as the 3rd, 6th, 9th, or 12th</term>, after all this, they will die a biothanata death. 

If the **Sun ☉** and **Saturn ♄** are positioned in the sixth or twelfth house from the **Horoscope**, they will be set over ineffective and miserable accounts; but these same stars always make them slow and languid in all things. If, however, **Mars ♂** regards them with a square or opposite aspect, he makes them criminals, bandits, perjurers, informers, and traitors of their own people; some, indeed, are delivered to dangers or custody because of slaves or condemned men, especially if **Mars ♂** regards the **Moon ☾** with any aspect. 

If **Saturn ♄** is found in the eighth house from the **Horoscope**, or in the anaphora of the **Horoscope** <note>the 2nd house</note>, and the **Moon ☾** is positioned in the anaphoras or epicataphoras, and **Mars ♂** is found in the seventh house from the **Horoscope**, he will make them set apart from all care of religions. If, however, with these things so arranged, **Saturn ♄** and the **Moon ☾** are found in square or opposite places to them, they will produce plunderers of temples, and those who, because of this, are punished with a public death. 

But if, with these things so arranged, **Jupiter ♃** and **Venus ♀** are found with them, they will produce priests, prophets, and <term>temple wardens; original: "neocoros"</term>, but nonetheless perishing by a biothanata death. 

If the **Moon ☾** with **Mars ♂** is found in the setting <note>the 7th house</note>, such that **Mars ♂** precedes in degrees, and **Saturn ♄** and **Mercury ☿** are positioned together in the **Midheaven**, they will produce biothanati.
